“What a feast. Lick it clean.”

With monsters above and monsters within, Jun-Su’s fight for survival turns into a chilling game of instinct, trust, and the brutal will to live.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189203.description:
"Seeing you writhe under me is super arousing." The beautiful fox demon, Natsume, has a hobby, and it's to play with humans by tricking them with his transformations! Today's target is a good-looking tailor, Takato. Even though Natsume invites him out of nowhere, Takato escorts him elegantly, and Natsume ends up getting drunk! When he woke up, he was at Takato's expensive apartment building. "I've never seen... such a sleek coat before." Natsume's sensitive ears and tail get teased, and with a deep kiss and gentle foreplay, he completely melts in Takato's arms...!!

(Source: Coolmic)
synonyms: 讓我觸摸你色情的尾巴！～禽獸紳士的寵溺性愛～

title.english: Let Me Touch Your Sexy Tail! -Beastly Gentleman's Loving Sex-
title.native: えっちなしっぽ、触らせろ！～ケダモノ紳士の溺愛セックス
title.romaji: Ecchi na Shippo, Sawarasero!: Kedamono Shinshi no Dekiai Sex

189204.description:
All Yeon-Woo wanted was to befriend the cute underclassman sitting next to him in class. But when his friendly gesture is met with an icy glare, he's left baffled. Things only get worse: elevator doors slammed in his face, sticky notes slapped on his back… What is this, elementary school?! Fed up with the childish pranks, Yeon-Woo decides he’s had enough. But just as tensions peak - bam! They're assigned to the same group project. And in the middle of Yeon-Woo’s fury...he suddenly bursts into tears?! What does this kid have against Yeon-Woo, and what will Yeon-Woo have to do to make things right?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: [성비단 견공주의] 선배, 저 기억 안 나요?
[Seongbidan Gyeongongjuui] Seonbae, Jeo Gieok An Nayo?
[Mr. Blue BL Short Stories] Dogism: Seonbae, Don't You Remember Me?

189205.description:
In my past life, I was Soonjung Lee, but I died from overwork. When I awoke in the novel I’m Choosing the Sub Male Lead in This Life!, I swore that I wouldn't suffer again--I'd get rich and live as I pleased! But the side character I transmigrated into, Penelope, is nothing more than the widowed baroness of a poor territory. I need to do better--I must become wealthy! But, unfortunately, to reach my goal I'll need the lord of the magic tower's help, and he’s not exactly the nicest guy...

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Don't Know the Original, I'm Busy Making a Living

title.english: I Couldn't Care Less About the Original, I'm Just Trying to Survive

189206.description:
Hiding behind an invisible mask, he takes on different identities, making money with his sleight of hand and silver tongue. One day, as he sets out to swindle yet another wealthy target—

"You're lying, aren't you?"

He encounters Chronica, a girl with a left eye that can read and manipulate the souls of others. Seeing through his deception, she not only robs him of all his wealth but also blackmails him into traveling with her. Determined to outwit her—and, more importantly, to reclaim his fortune—Linus uses every trick at his disposal to navigate a perilous journey filled with danger and challenges.

At the end of their road, what awaits them is the truth behind Chronica’s secret… and the deception Linus has been hiding all along.

A modern supernatural fantasy road movie—let the journey begin!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Note: Winner of the Grand Prize in the 19th MF Bunko J Light Novel Rookie Award.

title.native: マスカレード・コンフィデンス 詐欺師は少女と仮面仕掛けの旅をする
title.romaji: Masquerade Confidence: Sagishi wa Shoujo to Kamen Shikake no Tabi wo Suru

189207.description:
Kohaku Samejima works as a resident doctor at Usagi Children's Hospital. He aspired to become a pediatrician because he wanted to make children smile, but the children's hospital is full of crying faces everywhere. Naturally, the hospital prioritizes the future smiles of children who will be cured, not the present while they are undergoing treatment. Samejima, who still cannot give up on the "smiles of today" of children in such a field, meets Shio Tokita, a child life specialist (CLS) who specializes in the care of children's mental health.

(Source: Coamix, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: チャイルドリリーバー 宇左木こども病院の時田さん
title.romaji: Child Reliever: Usagi Kodomo Byouin no Tokita-san

189208.description:
Haru, is a stray cat who got picked up by a beautiful lady. After happily going home with her, he sees another cat, Rui, who is bigger and cooler than him! Haru, who sees Rui as a rival, says, "I will never get along with you!", But Rui just chuckles softly. One day, Haru, who had gotten shots at the hospital, suddenly gets a fever. He's thirsty, dizzy, and his penis aches...!! While Haru's body is in heat, the feeling of Rui's large hand is so nice—!? A heart-pounding, erotic BL with anthropomorphic tomcats, a love unfolds between a sweet and gentle fluffy black cat and a naive mischievous cat!

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.native: ハルとルイのにゃんだふるラブライフ!
title.romaji: Haru to Rui no Nyanderful Love Life!

189209.description:
Sang-Jeong, the mother of 17-year-old In-Jeong, is the owner of a restaurant with annual sales of tens of billions of won. One day, a middle-aged man with a different force visits the mother and daughter who have only walked the path of money. His name is Yeo Byeong-Hee. He was the unrequited love of Sang-Jeong, the mother, a long time ago... He appeared when Sang-Jeong, who was single, became famous as the owner of a restaurant! He brought his handsome 17-year-old son Yeo Woo-Jin, who is the same age as In-Jeong.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: The Foxes came to Our House

189210.description:
Popular virtual character streamer Keita has been searching for someone important to him—someone who vanished three years ago—while continuing his streaming activities. One day, he finds himself harassed by a group of strangers, only to be saved by a man with a voice he recognizes instantly. “This guy is mine,” the man declares—and to Keita’s shock, it’s none other than his long-lost childhood friend, Yasuna! Yasuna had moved to the U.S. due to family circumstances but returned because he wanted to see Keita again. As they reconnect, they realize their feelings for each other have always been mutual, and their hearts and bodies draw closer at an overwhelming pace.
Keita wishes for these happy moments to last forever—but Taina faces a trial he must overcome before they can truly be together…!

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

title.native: バーチャルくんはおさななじみを希う

189211.description:
After finding out her boyfriend has been cheating on her, Lee Da-Eun decides to forget him with a one-night stand. But as soon as Da-Eun returns to reality at her new job, she discovers that the guy she slept with is none other than Han Gyeoul, her boss! To make things even worse, he proposes to her out of the blue. Though shocked by his offer, Da-Eun gives him a chance. The only problem is, while Gyeoul may be a genius at work, he's a total fool when it comes to love! Does this pair have any hope?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 12 side story chapters.
synonyms: そのプロポーズは違法です！

189212.description:
Chae Eun-Soo just wants a stable life with no drama. After a wild night out leads her to sleep with a man she’s just met, she's relieved to find that he only slept next to her… and nothing more. When she runs into him again, he reveals his desperate need for some shut-eye, which only Eun-Soo could induce. He asks if they could sleep together again, and while he seems polite, she soon learns he’s not just a random stranger, but Seo Do-Jin, a boss from her company! So much for a drama-free life!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 上司と私のおかしなベッド事情

title.english: My Boss Can't Sleep Without Me

189213.description:
I was just a NEET, but one day I went to a convenience store and got killed by a robber. After that, a goddess suddenly appeared, took a liking to me, and I was successfully reincarnated in another world—but I came back as a "plant" of all things...! What's more, for some reason, every monster and human I meet is calling me "Lord World Tree"!? (Source: kuragebunch, translated)

Note: Three extra chapters are included.
synonyms: When I Was Reincarnated, I Was a World Tree

title.native: 転生したら世界樹だった件

189214.description:
When happiness is in full bloom...

(Source: FAKKU!)

Published in COMIC X-EROS ＃46.

189215.description:
Ju Do-Eun learned from an early age that people are fickle. As a result, she's focused solely on things that don't change—for example, her family's world-famous luxury handbag label IJu. In order to clinch her succession of the company, she agrees to get engaged to a famous designer to bring him on board. However, when she becomes entangled with police detective Gu Se-Young, she finds herself developing real feelings for the first time. Can Do-Eun learn to let her personal preferences take over?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: เรื่องรักส่วนบุคคล

189216.description:
"Mr. Esper, I told you already. I’m a B0-grade guide."

Lee Yeoni, a powerful dual-blood, has spent years hiding his striking looks and exceptional abilities while working in a quiet, rural town. But when circumstances force him to transfer to the capital, he finds himself entangled with Tae Hajin—an elite grade-S+ Esper with an intense, domineering presence.

Sensing that Yeoni is hiding something, Hajin becomes determined to uncover the truth. Using every trick at his disposal, he digs deeper into Yeoni’s secrets, setting off a tense battle of wits and wills.

Desperate to protect his identity, Yeoni resists Hajin’s pursuit—until he realizes he can turn the tables. If he must be exposed to danger, why not use Hajin as his shield? And so, he makes a bold decision…to become Hajin’s exclusive guide.

A gripping story of hidden power, dangerous attraction, and the fine line between hunter and hunted.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: เปิดประตูสู่มหันตภัย

189217.description:
Elizabeth is the richest heir in the empire. But after her parents’ sudden death, she’s told she must marry her uncle to claim her inheritance. No, thanks. So she fakes an engagement with her maid, runs away, and sets out to burn through the family fortune. Simple enough... until a drunken one-night stand with a man who looks like her first love throws everything off. And now he won’t stop following her!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Want to Go Bankrupt, Not Get Married
Forget Marriage, I'd Rather Go Bankrupt
Je préfère me ruiner que de me marier !

189218.description:
In the virtual reality dating app "PEENKY," spending money allows everyone to become their ideal selves, but the founder, Sheng Li, discovered that this app not only creates connections but also reveals many toxic relationships.

(Source: Webtoons, translated)
synonyms: สื่อรักแอปอลเวง

189219.description:
“Don’t hold back and let me see you go wild.” Overwhelmed by her first pleasure, she was brought to orgasm countless times… After being exiled to a monastery on false charges, Lucienne, the daughter of the Marquis, is abducted by Michael , a knight and duke of a neighboring country. His goal as duke was to get a cultivated wife. Secretly in love, she accepted a contract marriage immediately. As soon as she replied the duke approached her “Now you’re mine. I won’t let anyone else have you”!! As he gazed at her with a look of passion, he took her into his sturdy arms as though to imprison her and she felt as though she’d get the wrong impression that he has a feeling on her…! With melting kisses and passionate petting, she was soaking wet and at his mercy… This is a story of a romance between a duke gripped by his first love and a pure, sheltered heiress.

(Source: INKR Comics)

title.english: The Clingy Duke Wants to Take Everything From an Exiled Heiress
title.native: 愛が重い騎士公爵は、追放令嬢のすべてを奪い尽くしたい。 愛得太深沉的騎士公爵，想要奪得流放千金的一切。
title.romaji: Ai ga Omoi Kishi Koushaku wa, Tsuihou Reijou no Subete wo Ubai Tsukushitai.

189221.description:
In 2514 of the New Era, the apocalypse came. A world-class phenomenon appeared. Many strong mutated beasts have been wandering around the world since then. Humans are under deadly threats. They can only struggle for life. The one who will save everybody and protect the world from collapsing is... an average-looking barber from the slum?

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: After Merging With the Goddess, I Am Invincible

title.english: I Become Invincible after She Saves Me
title.native: 和女神合体后的我无敌了
title.romaji: He Nüshen Heti Hou De Wo Wudi le

189222.description:
Ángel once served Enzo Lars, heir to the powerful Lars family, as a servant, but he's now an esper and Enzo is his guide. From the very beginning, Enzo is outlandishly demanding. He wants something personal, intimate, and far beyond protocol. Twisted feelings that should’ve stayed in the past begin to surface again, fueled by power, obsession, and secrets. Behind Enzo’s calculated arrogance lies a dangerous longing, capturing Ángel in a bond he never agreed to and may not be able to escape.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189223.description:
Once a year on a cold midwinter night in the Empire of Hartan, a fortress of frost appears, revealing the resting place of a blue-eyed demon said to grant any wish – for a price. When Princess Estelle of Hartan flees her abusive imperial family, she is encounters the otherworldly Frost Fort and makes a pact with Satael, the blue-eyed demon of legend. Pledging her body and soul to him, Estelle begins to plot for the crown.

(Source: WEBTOON)

189224.description:
Kohaku has never been in love and has no desire to get married. However, after her mother's hospitalization, she began to question her own future, and decided to start looking for a life partner. Although she has never been in a romantic relationship, she believes that marriage is possible even without love… Prepared with data and research, she jumps into the matchmaking scene, but the world of marriage matching is not so easy! Dating apps, matchmaking parties… Kohaku is faced with all sorts of challenges as she tries various avenues to marriage. Will she finally find her match?

(Source: A-WAGON, translated)
synonyms: ぶった斬り婚活!～それでも私は結婚したい?～
Buttagiri Konkatsu! - Soredemo Watashi wa Kekkon Shitai?

189225.description:
Heron Quinn, who traversed into a parallel modern city, unexpectedly inherited the position of the current Taoist Master at Serenity Taoist Temple. Moreover, he was bound to the Taoist Master System, allowing him to receive rewards for completing daily tasks. Heron initially thought he could live a peaceful life, but to his surprise, he was forced to spar with a live streamer in traditional martial arts. As Heron raised his palm into the air, golden lightning transformed into a sword. He smiled and said, "I don't know traditional martial arts, but I do know a bit of the thunder technique."

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: The Taoist Master Who Summons Thunder
title.native: 国术？贫道不会，我只会雷法！
title.romaji: Guoshu? Pindao Buhui, Wo Zhi Hui Lei Fa!

189226.description:
Sumire is a popular model who's newly engaged. She has a sister named Nobara. At the engagement party, Nobara discovers a shocking fact: Sumire, has been deliberately stealing the men Nobara's fallen in love with, calling it a fun "game". Furthermore, the man Sumire chose to marry was Hikaru, someone Nobara's always admired and stood by at work... Having learned the truth, Nobara joins the "game", seeking revenge by any means necessary...!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.native: 姉妹逆転ゲーム ～ずっと嫌っていた美しすぎる姉～

title.romaji: Saikyou Kyuutei Shinanyaku no Ossan, Tsuihousareta Hekichi de Musou Suru: Maboroshi to Natta Shuzoku no Bishoujo-tachi wo Sodatete Henkyou wo Kaitaku

I head on my way to visit the grave of my older sister.
This is a tale of pure love, so you can read it with peace of mind.

(Source: DLsite)

synonyms: As if it were a tale

189230.description: Fourteen years after a hero's sacrifice defeated the Demon Lord, a prodigious boy becomes a teacher at a monster academy despite being only 14. One of his students, a demon girl, resents him for his age and humanity. He reveals his true strength and purpose at the academy.

title.native: センセイ、魔王を殺して

189231.description:
Office worker Yura has been living with his super cold and unfriendly daycare teacher boyfriend, Kaji, for six months. Every time Kaji unexpectedly smiles, Yura can’t help but feel happy.
However, there’s one unexpected problem—Kaji is a total stamina monster, and Yura just can’t keep up in bed! Determined to satisfy his boyfriend, he pushes himself to improve… only to be suddenly rejected.
Has Kaji already grown tired of him…!?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

title.native: 溺愛カレシは仏頂面してやってくる
title.romaji: Dekiai Kareshi wa Bucchouzura Shite Yattekuru

189232.description:
I'm gonna reverse rape you! ♪

189233.description:
Zeo, a poor necromancer, receives a request for an exorcism and visits a certain mansion. As he prepares to start his work, the client, a woman named Luca, seems to be plotting something. In reality, she is a vampire who lured Zeo in with a fake request to drink his blood. Thus begins a chaotic and over-the-top gothic romance between the two.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ネクロマンサーはてんてこまい!!

189234.description:
The main character cherishes the grandmother she lives with. However, one day, the beloved grandmother passes away, leaving her completely alone. In the midst of this loss, a hidden ability awakens—she possesses a supernatural power where the more she punches, the stronger she becomes. This exhilarating battle manga follows a seemingly innocent girl as she relentlessly takes down those who act unfairly.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

189235.description:
Everyone knows the tale of a poor girl, abused by step-sisters and helped by her fairy godmother. Stella knows the story well, but she finds herself reincarnated as a wicked stepsister-the classic villainess role! Rather than playing along, Stella tries to befriend Cinderella instead!

An unconventional, perhaps slightly more realistic take on a classic fairy tale.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Thought I was Reincarnated as a Noble Villainess, but I Actually Ended up as Cinderella's Older Stepsister A Cinderella Otaku's Isekai Reincarnation
title.native: 悪役令嬢に転生したと思ったら、シンデレラの義姉でした ～シンデレラオタクの異世界転生～
title.romaji: Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shita to Omottara, Cinderella no Gishi deshita: Cinderella Otaku no Isekai Tensei

189236.description:
Individuals who return from death as Terminal Revenants are granted unique abilities that allow them to surpass human limits. They have the power to steal the lifespan of others. Twenty-one years ago, the worst of these revenants, Hae-su Shin, disappeared without a trace after killing 144 people and stealing everything. Now, a revenge 20 years in the making begins, aimed at capturing the most dangerous of these resurrected beings.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

189237.description: Princess Lavia of the Icyn Kingdom lived peacefully with her father and the people. But one night, the kingdom was attacked by bandits along with a mysterious mist. In despair, Lavia's ice powers went out of control and her body froze, but she was saved by Emperor Sieghelm of the Freygamdo Empire, who had the fire power. "I pray that you won't freeze while holding me," "...Don't worry. This ice won't put out my fire." Sieghelm melts Lavia's frozen heart and body with his fire and love. Who is the culprit who attacked the Icyn Kingdom? And why is Sieghelm so obsessed with Lavia...? A romance fantasy about the possessive fire emperor and the noble ice princess.

title.native: 独占欲が強い炎帝に執着されてます
title.romaji: Dokusen Yoku ga Tsuyoi Honou Tei ni Shuuchaku Saretemasu

189238.description:
As the second daughter of the affluent Daeju Group family, Yoon Seung-ah should have a perfect life of luxury. However, the dismal truth is that she has experienced nothing but contempt and restriction simply for being an illegitimate child. Then, one day, in a strange twist of events, Seung-ah meets Ki Taejun from the KCT Group, who wants to strike up a deal in exchange for helping her regain her freedom and sense of self. And for the first time, she decides to give in to her impulses which sets in motion an array of complications and desires…

(Source: Tappytoon)

189239.description:
We will kill each other fair and square, in good sportsmanship! "When 42-year-old businessman Takahiko Ago finds himself in a very different world. It is the same modern Japan, except that a sport called "D-sport," in which killing is the right thing to do, has become very popular. The loser is immediately killed. Violators of the rules are also immediately killed. Gogo does not yet know that he will be participating in such an outlandish sport. The first event is the "D500m run. The unreasonable athletic meet is about to begin!

(Source: Yanmanga, translated)

189240.description:
Mao, a timid office worker, gets hit by a bicycle and switches bodies with a demon lord from another world.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: まおーえる！～社畜OLと異世界最強魔王入れ替わり生活～
title.romaji: MaOL!: Shachiku OL to Isekai Saikyou Maou Irekawari Seikatsu

Distorted but wanted... Bromance-action comic where men's emotions intersect!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: ヨコスカ・ブロマンス

189244.description:
Hyewon is in for the surprise of a lifetime when she suddenly gets a marriage proposal from her boss and longtime crush, Jihoon. Everything's perfect except for the fact that it's a loveless fake marriage! However, Jihoon's sizzling kiss to seal the deal leaves her completely defenseless. Instead of refusing, she decides to seize the chance and accepts the two-year faux marriage to try and make him truly hers. Can she turn this fake arrangement into a genuine love story?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: この上なく完璧な結婚

189245.description:
In an accident, Mu Haohao transmigrated to the world of a one-versus-five erotic novel. She is bound to a system in the novel and becomes the female lead. In order to return to the real world, the system requires Mu Haohao to complete a task. However, the task is to win the hearts of the five male leads simultaneously! Yet, she only wants to be with one man all her life! Initially, she tried to break away from the novel's original settings. Unfortunately, she got reborn again, and this time, the five male leads were reborn with memories of their previous lives intact...

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: Becoming the Treasured Pet of 5 Big Shots

"If it's you, I don't mind doing it with a man." In a world filled with Alphas who have special demon powers, Hibiki is an omega who has the power to turn into a demon. He hides his identity and is on a mission to defeat monsters. Masato, his junior who can also turn into a demon, is a playboy and they don't get along well. One day, during a mission, Hibiki suddenly gets into heat and Masato finds out that he's an omega...!! "Ah, sorry, I can't hold back any longer." Masato shoves his hot dick into Hibiki's wet butt by force. A BL story between a younger alpha and confident tsundere omega who are on very bad terms!

synonyms: 倔強的鬼大人是專屬於我的Ω

title.romaji: Tsuyoki na Oni-sama wa Ore Dake no Ω

189247.description:
That day, I killed myself to protect the "family structure."
For everyone who is worried about their relationship with their parents.
A comic about the real life story of a young carer who regains lost emotions!

A mother with schizophrenia, a father who is indifferent to the family, a younger brother who is treated specially, a grandfather with dementia...
Yui has been taking care of her family since kindergarten, doing everything she can, including shopping, cooking, cleaning, and laundry.
She endured her mother's violence as a child, suppressing her "childishness," and did her best to survive, and now as an adult, she is aware of herself as a "young carer."
This is a story of her rebirth, as she struggles with problems through work, marriage, and child-rearing, but regains her lost emotions.

(source: Bunshun, translated)
synonyms: It seems like I'm the only one getting older. - A young carer's diary

title.native: 私だけ年を取っているみたいだ。　ヤングケアラーの再生日記
title.romaji: Watashi dake Toshi wo Totte Iru Mitai da. - Young Carer no Saisei Nikki

189249.description:
A skilled cook but hopelessly incompetent at everything else, the naturally airheaded chef Iokawa Kei works alongside his longtime frenemy, the quiet yet effortlessly charming bartender Ooga Azusa. At "Granada," a beloved bar known for its delicious drinks and well-paired dishes, the two bicker constantly yet manage to work together in relative harmony. One day, however, Kei stumbles upon a shocking scene—Azusa pinning down their boss, Yoda, in the backroom…!?

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: こじらせハツコイ、10年目のたわごと

189250.description:
"What is it, Mr. Amakusa? Don't tell me you're planning to make midnight visits to my bed?" Aki Kurumi, 29 years old, meets Shisui Amakusa at a singles' mixer, and what should he unexpectedly propose but a paper marriage...! And once she starts living with Shisui, who is a touch out of sync with her, it kicks off a string of miscommunications and minor catastrophes! Their life as newlyweds (on paper) gets off to a bumpy start, but it's somehow almost cozy... "I didn't realize I would be so happy... to be needed by someone." They each chose this paper marriage for their own convenience, but could they become a real husband and wife? What is "love"? What is "marriage"? This is a bumbling love story that depicts how men and women coexist.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: Who Needs Love When We've Got Marriage!
title.native: 恋したくないので、結婚します！
title.romaji: Koi Shitakunai no de, Kekkon Shimasu!

189251.description:
Separated by status and species, two men will find love in a desperate attempt to escape the oppressive hierarchy of their society.

Luta, a new race of humans that have animal genes and characteristics, quickly grew in population until humans became the minority. Now, the Luta keep humans as pets, using them to satisfy their sexual appetites and urges, something that Ernetis finds disgusting and despicable. Though he's also a Luta, he's never been fond of the way his kind treats humans. But when a party goes awry and a human named Jin breaks free from his tiger beastman keeper, Ernetis will find himself helping the brave escapee.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Kaze no Yume Hana no Yume

189253.description:
In a long-awaited reunion with his middle school classmates, Kusui was enjoying old reminiscences, but suddenly remembered someone. It was a classmate named Chizuruwa who he was dating at the time. He was petite, had a cute smile, and was his first love. He was also his first lover, and he couldn't forget him no matter how hard he tried. While he was feeling nostalgic, his classmate brought Chizuruwa, saying that they had met at work and invited him...!?

(Source: Kasakura Shuppan, translated)

Notes: Includes one extra chapter.

189254.description:
Ginji (65), who has devoted himself to work in a rural town in Nagano, rich in nature, retired on his birthday. Just the next day, when he and his wife had planned to spend their retirement years in peace, Ginji's wife suddenly passes away.
Three weeks later, his daughter, her husband and his adoptive father Momota (53), came to check on him and discover Ginji in a daze, with his room in disarray.
While Momota was efficiently cleaning up the house, Ginji ends up drowning in the bathtub, leaving him in a dangerous state. As Momota hesitates to administer artificial respiration, he regains consciousness.
Seeing Momota's face turning red at his nude sight, Ginji is surprised saying, "You're making a voice like a woman" but in fact Momota is gay...
Ginji (Silver), a stubborn old man from the Showa era who lost his wife and has zero housekeeping skills, and Momota (Pink), a devilish gay former middle school teacher with low self-esteem and a handicap, live under the same roof and grow closer as they are taught how to do housework, in this middle-aged elderly care home x BL!? x drama!

(Source: Shufunotomo, translated)

189255.description:
Club Heaven - a place where the charming staff will save you with all their heart and soul.
Ikumi, a salaryman who is on the edge of his limit, enduring power harassment from his boss every day, is introduced to the referral-only brothel, Club Heaven, by his senior, who can't stand seeing him in such a bad state, with the suspicious words, "There is salvation there".
Ikumi decides to give it a try and chooses Manato, a staff member dressed as a nun, as recommended. Manato gently embraces him with his captivating breasts and completely accepts him, and before he knows it, his body and mind are melting away...!?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)
synonyms: Club Heaven in the Roppongi Piggery

title.native: クラブヘブンin六本木豚舎

This 5 volume collection compiles some of Kyouko Ariyoshi's favorite manga and essay from her own bibliography, alongside brand new interviews, commentary, and essays about her life and work.

Volume 1: Koneko to Shoujo
1. Koneko to Shoujo (仔ネコと少女)
2. Hakuchou no Uta wo Kiite! (白鳥の歌をきいて！)
3. Yurushite Mama! (許してママ！)
4. Motomu! Hanamuko-dono (求む！花ムコどの)

Volume 2: Unicorn to Aibou-tachi
1. Unicorn to Aibou-tachi (ユニコーンと相棒たち)
2. Cabbage-hatake no Kodomo-tachi (キャベツ畑の子どもたち)

Volume 3: SWAN Selection

2. Odette-hime no Yuuutsu (オデット姫のゆ・う・う・つ)

1. Yume Message (夢・メッセージ)
2. San Fransisco Monogatari (サンフランシスコ物語)

Volume 5: Tenshi no Sumu Ie
1. Bruges (ブルージュ)
2. Tenshi no Sumu Ie (天使の棲む家)
3. Kyuuseishu Nyuumon (救世主入門)

189260.description:
The story follows the villainess Chloe, who is about to be executed. Upon her death, she vows to live a righteous life upon reincarnation. In modern-day Japan, Chloe is reincarnated as Kuroe, a smelly middle-aged man.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Uncle Reincarnation: The Villainess's Days of Aging Gracefully

title.native: おじ転生～悪役令嬢の加齢なる生活～
title.romaji: Oji Tensei: Akuyaku Reijou no Kareinaru Seikatsu

189263.description:
Lucia is the captain of the imperial knights and a swordmaster famous for her extraordinary achievements. However, she regrets something on her deathbed: unknowingly aiding a nefarious group in their plot to sacrifice the saintess for profit. So when she wakes up in the past as her 25-year-old self, Lucia is determined to rescue the child saintess and keep her safe until she’s old enough to protect herself. But the formidable knight is completely clueless when it comes to raising a child... Will six months of maternity leave be enough time for her to figure things out? The following series contains depictions of child abuse that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The Monster Dame Requests Maternity Leave

189264.description:
Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: จอมเวทนอกรีตแห่งหอคอยขาว
As Crianças Problemáticas da Torre Mágica

189265.description:
Reborn with memories she never asked for, Jian Song wants nothing more than a quiet, ordinary life. But everything changes when she meets him again—the man she once loved beyond reason, and the one who shattered her. No matter how hard she tries to stay away, fate keeps pulling them together in ways she never expected. As her new life begins to mirror the tragic patterns of her past, she must face one question: can she rewrite her story this time, or is she doomed to repeat it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

189266.description:
In a world where ordinary people possess superpowers, becoming a superhero is no longer an unattainable dream. However, for him, who lacks superpowers but aspires to be a hero, he can only embark on the path of cultivating immortality. You have superpowers, so what? With immortal magic, saving the world only requires the wave of a finger!

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: No More Pretending, I'm Stronger Than Superheroes
Do I Have a Screw Lose in My Head for Cultivating in a World of Superpowers?
Who Am I? I Am the Strongest Hero
非能力者だが俺は仙道でヒーローを目指す

title.english: Chosen to be Immortal in the World of Superpower
title.romaji: Bu Zhuang le, Wo Bi Yingxiong Huan Qiang

189267.description:
Hong Dal-Gi, the detective who lost everything due to one mistake, Yu-Jin, a violent detective who receives disciplinary action as if it were a meal, and an elite informant who graduated at the top of his class at the police academy. These three detectives who do not get along at all form a team and gradually become one as they solve cases.

(Source: Naver, translated)

189268.description:
Three years ago, the Emperor Alliance was disbanded. The gaming prodigy Mo Bei retired quietly. Three years later, the prodigy returned crossed-dressing as a man and hiding his identity. She once again stepped back up onto the altar from a state of shame, drawing the cheers of everyone! He was handsome and had no time for love. He had countless fans, and everyone knew him in the eSports industry. He then said to her when she first joined the team, “Keep your head down, and don’t try to take things that you don’t deserve.” When her identity was revealed, he looked at her from behind his desk and stood up.

“You want to abandon me just like that when we just got married ingame? Hm?”

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: The Ace has a Secret Crush on Me

189270.description:
One day, high schooler Makoto discovers a mysterious red number "222" on his pinky finger. Visible only to him, the number decreases by one each day. What fate awaits him when the countdown hits zero?

(Source: Manga Plus)

189271.description:
Let's be together forever. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2015-12

title.native: 淫乱OL 沢渡登喜子～女達の淫靡な素顔～
title.romaji: Inran OL Sawatari Tokiko: Onna-tachi no Inbi na Sugao

189276.description:
A monster that eats people, takes away their appearance and memory, and replaces them, " Werewolf". Wolves are integrated into human society, and they prolong their lives by eating people so that they cannot be understood by their surroundings. Someone who was close to me yesterday may be a fake today. When the fate of such a monster and the young man who "gostain" of "life" intersects, a strange story begins.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: The Werewolf Who Wants to Stay Alive

189277.description:
In a world where the secondary sexes of Dom and Sub exist...

Office worker Shino is aware that he doesn't even make the cut for the lowest tier of the Sub population, which wrecks his confidence and makes it hard for him to find a partner. One day, he happens to run into Triple S―tier Dom and super hot model Aoha, whose mesmerizing gaze causes Shino to faint right on the spot. The two test out their physical chemistry strictly as a means to take care of their health, and Aoha's commands resonate throughout Shino's entire body. After a wild night where they both lose themselves to pleasure, they decide to continue their arrangement... Perhaps love really can blossom from dominating and being dominated...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ブラットテイマー／キング
黒の歌姫 -ヤミノエニシ-
title.romaji: Kuro no Utahime: Yami no Enishi

title.native: おもいあい♥モノポライズ
君とブルーに染まる頃
title.romaji: Kimi to Blue ni Somaru Koro

189281.description:
"In 24 hours, you will die.” One day, the Grim Reaper appears in front of Taira, a junior in college. Will Taira be able to make the most of the limited time left in his life?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

189282.description:
Kugimoto Iroha has appeared on several Shouwa Saishuu Sensen doujins and now we have her origin story.

We already know she's a massive perverted masochist, but now we see how she got there~

(Source: Fakku!)

title.native: 変態お便女クロニクル

189284.description:
In 2054, when only 40% of the population has survived due to a crisis caused by humans, the entire planet agrees to a 'Regenerative Human Era' where the environment is the absolute top priority. Half a century later, in a society where all pursuit of individuality, including fashion other than daily necessities, is not only forbidden but sinful, five reckless middle school students, each with their own reasons for wanting to be fashionable, come together to form a 'Secret Fashion Club...! The wild fashion story of brave middle school students!

(Source: Naver, translated)

189285.description:
I have to defeat the great monster! ???: I'm 8 years old? An exorcism boys' manga featuring the cute and soft priestess Sea and the gloomy exorcist Shio!

(Source: Naver, translated)

189286.description:
"How nice it would be if I could just sleep soundly for one day without thinking about anything."

Kim Ga-Hee, a nurse who is exhausted from her current life due to excessive work stress and who spends her days listless without a single person close to her, lost her memories of nearly five years due to a sudden accident. The problem is that she seems to have had a boyfriend.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: A Woman Who Lost 4 Years and 6 Months

189287.description:
The cheerful and handsome Shion and the seemingly cool but secretly a fudanshi, Sota, have become a couple and are happily (and sometimes intimately) spending time together. However, one day, Shion unexpectedly says, "I want to introduce you to my mom." Sota, who hasn’t yet come out to anyone about his relationship with Shion, struggles with what to do next—what should he say? His internal conflict deepens as he tries to figure out how to handle the situation.

(Source: Homesha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 続!!腐男子くんには秘密がある
title.romaji: Zoku!! Fudanshi-kun ni wa Himitsu ga Aru

189288.description:
Rai has been secretly crushing on her childhood friend Do-Gyeong for years. To hide her feelings, she pretends to be a die-hard fan of the K-pop group DIMPLE, especially of Neulchan, her "ultimate bias." It's all just fun and games to make Do-Gyeong a little jealous... until Neulchan suddenly transfers to her school. With her fake idol crush now a real part of her life, her friendship with Do-Gyeong starts to spiral. One fake crush, and one real crush—can Rai keep up the act, or is her secret about to come out?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

189291.description:
Li Hao discovered that his family and friends around him died one after another according to the order mentioned in the lyrics of an old ballad, and that he would be the next one to die! As he delves deeper into his investigation, everything appears to be related to the ancient ruins of Constellation Door, where supernatural abilities were awakened decades ago...

(Source: Webnovel)

189292.description:
Imari Shuuya (26) works at a high school with a strict new policy: “In-school romance is forbidden—break this rule and you’re fired.” As a serious professional, he figures teachers shouldn’t be wasting time on love when they have students to look after anyway. But his convictions are shaken when the school’s new and strikingly handsome nurse, Yotsumi Rio (22), begins pursuing him with alarming devotion!

A cat-and-mouse BL romance between a straight-laced, bespectacled teacher and the yandere school nurse who’s determined to make him fall!

(Source: Manga UP!)

Notes:
- Originally published as a one-shot on Gangan Online, was then picked up for serialization.
- During serialization, Chapters 2, 11, and 12 were split into two parts while Chapters 3 to 10 and 13 were split into three parts. These were all combined in the volume releases.
- Includes 10 extra chapters.

189293.description:
"Please, do not leave me."

"We should get a divorce. You don't love me, do you? We... only got married for our families' sake."

"Why… Why are you saying such things? Did I do something wrong to you? If you want me to kneel, I will. If you don’t like my face, I will wear a mask for the rest of my life. So, please… please, do not leave my side."

My husband, whom I married through an arranged marriage, is the second male lead who harbors an unrequited love for the heroine of The Saintess’ Wish, the novel I have possessed. And I, his lawful wife, am destined to endure a lonely marriage before meeting a mysterious death. For my own survival—and for his love—I decided to cleanly end our marriage. But…

"Why is he holding onto me? Aren’t you supposed to love Aria???"

"This novel’s world… is different from what I knew. What is the truth?"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Ugly Wife of the Shady Duke

189294.description:
It's your fault for being deceived...

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2015-10

189296.description: It is now Cosmic Era (C.E.) 75, two years after the dismantlement of the Destiny Plan, but warfare still continues to rage on between Naturals and Coordinators. Independence movements are now sprouting up across Earth, and invasions by Blue Cosmos grow exponentially stronger... To deal with these predicaments, a World Peace Supervision Organization known as COMPASS has been established, with PLANT Chairwoman Lacus Clyne as the founding leader. Kira Yamato and the others, as its new members, intervene into various battles for the sake of this peace. However, as these battles take place, an emergent nation known as 'FOUNDATION' appears, and they propose a joint operation to attack the Blue Cosmos Headquarters. Will Destiny run its course, or will Kira still have the Freedom to resist against impossible odds?

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムSEED FREEDOM

189297.description:
Nina Kamisato is a corporate drone, always heading home on the last train. But one night, when she's about to eat her late dinner, she's suddenly transported to another world (along with her rice cooker) as part of a saintess summoning ritual. Unfortunately, her beautiful, young neighbor ends up being summoned along with her and is immediately assumed to be the true saintess. Thus, Nina is banished from the royal capital.

Alone in an unknown world with nothing other than her rice cooker, what's a girl to do?! As she tries to wrap her head around what had just ensued, a puppy-like creature then appears before her... An adorable, heartwarming tale of an overworked woman turned exiled saintess, her handsome Sacred Beast companion, and their leisurely adventures traveling and cooking.
synonyms: I'm a Saintess Who Was Exiled, so My Fluffy Servant (Holy Beast) and I Make Onigiri

title.english: I Was Exiled for Supposedly Not Being the Saintess and Now I Make Rice Balls with My Fluffy (Sacred Beast) Servant
title.native: 聖女じゃないと追放されたので、もふもふ従者（聖獣）とおにぎりを握る
title.romaji: Seijo ja Nai to Tsuihou Sareta node, Mofumofu Juusha (Seijuu) to Onigiri wo Nigiru

189299.description: In a world where humans battle monsters, the skilled Saint Sia is tasked to defeat the Demon King but finds herself labeled incompetent and banished from the Hero's party. But instead of despairing, she's actually thrilled! This is her chance to meet truly wonderful and top-notch companions! Determined to build a guild that values character over strength, she seeks out her ideal party members. Her recruits are a mix of odd yet charming individuals: a sincere and hardworking young man living as a vagrant, an endearingly naive little girl, and a clumsy older man—ordinary folk notable only for their kindness. With her Saintly powers, Sia recognizes their hidden talents and helps them flourish through quests. Though still rough around the edges, they might just become strong enough to take on the Demon King! With the resourceful guild leader by their side, perhaps they can become something more.
synonyms: I Was Fired From the Saints and Heroes Party and Created a Guild, and It Has Grown Into the Strongest Guild Like My Home
성녀, 용사 파티에서 해고 당해 길드를 만들었더니 내 집 같은 최강의 길드로 성장했습니다
The Saint Fired From the Hero's Party Created a Guild at Home, and It Grew Into the Strongest Guild
I, a Saint, Was Dismissed from the Hero Party; Therefore, I Established a Guild, Which Grew up to Be the Strongest One Having a Homey Atmosphere @comic

title.native: 聖女、勇者パーティーから解雇されたのでギルドを作ったらアットホームな最強ギルドに育ちました。@COMIC
title.romaji: Seijo, Yuusha Party kara Kaiko Sareta node Guild wo Tsukuttara Atto Home na Saikyou Guild ni Sodachimashita。 @COMIC

189300.description:
A humble chemistry teacher loses his life in an unfortunate accident and is reincarnated as Roca, a farmer in a fantasy world. Roca has an adorable and devoted wife named Arc, but he is a textbook hopeless man who borrows money from Arc to gamble. Roca, who falls in love with Arc at first sight, uses his innate chemistry knowledge and the given "purification skill" to solve all kinds of problems in order to make Arc smile. Gradually, his activities catch the eye of the royal nobility, and he gets caught up in an interstate war... [Credits] Original Story: Hiroki Nosuka, Name: Shake no. Marinade, Character Design/Line Art: Doya, Divine Beast Design: Unamiso, Background Production/Coloring/Finishing: Inaho Inc., Scientific Supervision: Katsunori Sato, Production: Minto Studio

(Source: Mangadex)

title.native: 愛妻家すぎるサイエンティストは救国の英雄になる
title.romaji: Aisaika Sugiru Scientist wa Kyuukoku no Eiyuu ni Naru

189301.description:
The real me is extremely perverted. ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Bavel 2015-10

title.native: なりきりエッチ 美翔ちゃん

189302.description:
One day, while walking on the beach, an old man and his dog Fujio came across a baby mermaid. He named it Aki-chan, but the old man had lost his wife early and had no children, so he knew nothing about raising a child. And what's more, it was a baby mermaid! He didn't know what to feed it or even how mermaids lived! So begins the old man's struggle to raise the mermaid on his own!!

(source: Kodansha, translated)

189303.description: I'm Amiru, a Reiwa-era gal who loves anything that gets me super hyped☆ I used to hate myself. but thanks to a kind Heisei-era gal onee-san, I learned to love who I am♪ From giving a strict morals committee guy a makeover and finding out he's actually pretty hot, to blowing up on social media... all sorts of crazy things happen, but with full gal power, I’m living every day fired up and having a blast!

title.native: イイネ！ＲＥＩＷＡギャル★あみるん

189305.description:
Lee Chul-Joong, a team leader in the Jae-Young faction, isn’t thrilled about the arrival of a new director from the entertainment industry. What could someone like that possibly know about "real" business? But when Chul-Joong meets the director for the first time—while secretly carrying drugs in his person—things take an unexpected turn. In a twist of fate, he strikes the deal of a lifetime with Director Choi Ha-Gyeong, the perfect deal that could either destroy him or completely turn his world upside down.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

189306.description:
A poor commoner chatterbox accidentally entered the celebrity high school and the unthinkable happened…?

Notes:
- Includes the one-shot "Onna Kyoushi wa 16-sai. (女教師は16歳。)".
- Includes the one-shot "Mouai♥Idol!! (妄愛♥アイドル!!)".
synonyms: The Lying Prince's Game of Pretending To Be a Couple

title.native: 嘘つき王子のカレカノごっこ

189307.description:
"Jae-Hee, why do you always carry two copies of your script?" "Well, you might lose them."

That's a lie. One is for carrying around to the filming set and showing it to others. The other is. [The drama 'Youth Train' can be absorbed.] [Would you like to absorb it?] It is for my own consumption. I devour the script and make it mine alone. The story of Jae-Hee, an actor who can absorb a script 100%.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

189308.description:
Saal Cooper was the perfect "shadow" of the Cooper family. He was loyal, powerful, and... expendable. Spellbound to be Eren Cooper's human shield, Saal took all the wounds and pain meant for his master, making him an invincible hero. When the family discards him like a broken tool, Saal discovers the horrifying truth behind his lifelong agony. Betrayed and left to die, he reverses the spell with his final breath, reclaiming his stolen power. But death grants him an unexpected gift when he is reborn as his three-year-old self. This time, Saal is determined not to live in the shadows.

(Source: Tappytoon)

synonyms: Rules For Getting Along With the Vicious Dog Husband

title.native: 和恶犬丈夫的相处法则
title.romaji: He E Quan Zhangfu De Xiangchu Faze

189310.description:
Ciella Leroix reincarnated into a story she read in her past life. Although her name and backstory resemble that of Cinderella, she is not the main character in this story. She spent most of her life being mistreated by her family, and she was almost sold off into marriage until a handsome duke struck a deal with her. After years of distrusting others, she opens up to him only to have her hope shattered once again. Ciella soon realizes that the only way for her to be happy… is to disappear.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ซินเดอเรลล่าที่หายไป
シンデレラにお別れを

189311.description:
The hometown of Miharu's missing mother was a beach village with a torii gate facing the sea. As the once-in-60-years grand festival to choose Ozan approaches, Miharu decides to go to the island of the shrine!

(source: KManga, translated)

189312.description:
Inside a trap known as salvation...

(Source: FAKKU!)

Published in COMIC X-EROS ＃72.

189313.description:
"Time keeps rewinding to one month before my divorce...!?" Will this hopeless husband, completely unaware of his crumbling family, realize his mistakes and escape from the time loop...!?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: エンドレス離婚～もしも結婚生活をやり直せたなら～
title.romaji: Endless Rikon - Moshimo Kekkon Seikatsu wo Yarinaosetanara

189314.description:
One fateful night, Sung-Hoon, a music professor, and his family suffer a devastating accident. While their son, Hyun-Woo, escapes relatively unscathed, his parents are not so lucky. Months later, Sung-Hoon wakes up. It turns out, his perfect life wasn’t quite so perfect. Will he finally escape his wife’s control? Or does Hyun-Woo have his own plans for his father?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

189315.description:
One sunny day day, a portal burst open in the garden, and Kwon Jae-Jin got caught up in the chaos. His limbs were torn off, and he died...

…Or so he thought.

When he wakes up, he finds himself back on the first day of his captivity—with Seo Wui-Wu between his legs, tugging at his pants. Jae-Jin stares down at the familiar face, one he had come to resent over the four agonizing years of his previous life. Back then, he had believed he was merely a victim, dragged into an unfamiliar place and forced into submission. But this time is different. Now, Jae-Jin knows exactly how Seo Wui-Wu thinks, what moves him, and—most importantly—how to control him. With the promise of guiding as bait, Seo Wui-Wu will be his to manipulate. As Seo Wui-Wu’s breath grows heavy and his dark hair falls messily over his forehead, his hungry gaze flashes with dangerous excitement. Who will truly hold the reins in this second chance at fate?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: My Second Chance on Taming an Obsessed Esper
Unrivaled Samurai: The Strongest Samurai of the Sengoku Period Conquers Another World

title.native: サムライ無双～戦国最強のサムライ、異世界を征く～
title.romaji: Samurai Musou: Sengoku Saikyou no Samurai, Isekai wo Seiku

189317.description:
Kang Oh-Hyun, who pretended to be heterosexual and appeared on the dating variety show . But his first one-night stand partner was the main PD of the program! The main PD, Jeong-Wook, gave Oh-Hyun a harsh scolding for appearing on the program while hiding the fact that he was gay…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Blühen's Ssasek Danpyeonseon (싸섹 단편선) Collection.

189318.description:
It was a beautiful mermaid who saved me...

We have only one wish. I want to be with you forever... But God won't even grant that wish...?

"I'll always believe and wait for the day I can see you again." I live in a port town with a beautiful sea view. I'm happy every day surrounded by my childhood friend Nagi and the kind people of the town. But I have a dream that I really want to make come true. It's to be reunited with a "certain boy." Seven years ago, that boy with a beautiful face who saved me from drowning in the sea had the form of a mermaid... But even so, I want to see you one more time. And then, a mermaid appears before me...

Where will my fate lead to with the mermaid boy...?

(source: Shogakukan Comic, translated)

189320.description:
Introverted and overly self-conscious, Aizawa secretly admires his café coworker, Risa. But no matter how hard he tries, he just can’t express his feelings.
Enter the café manager, Rion—who completely ignores Aizawa’s feelings and throws him into one unexpected situation after another!?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

189321.description:
Having fulfilled his childhood dream, Kashino Yūki finally debuts as a rookie voice actor. His greatest wish? To perform alongside his childhood friend, Kōsaka Izumi, who is three years older and already a successful, well-known voice actor. Determined to catch up to Izumi, Yūki puts in relentless effort—until one day, his dream comes true. They are cast together in a project… But the job is a BL drama CD, a genre Yūki has no experience with. Struggling with his role and feeling discouraged, he confesses, "I just can’t seem to imagine what ‘pleasure’ sounds like…" To which Izumi, ever the helpful senior, suggests a hands-on lesson…!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: たいへんよく鳴けました

189322.description:
Shiba Tsukasa is a manga artist who has been dating his childhood friend and senior editor, Kazuto, for six months. Having only experienced immature romance in the past, Tsukasa enjoys how Kazuto showers him with kisses and affection every day. However, for some reason, Kazuto refuses to take things all the way. Tsukasa longs to catch up to an adult romance, but Kazuto keeps treating him like a child…
One day, Tsukasa accidentally meets Kazuto’s ex, a man with a mature aura. Doubt creeps in—Am I not enough for him…?

(Source: Hobunsha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: かまってほしい志羽先生

189324.description:
Childhood friends and inseparable best friends, Katsumi and Minoru are the center of attention at their high school. Their striking looks, constant togetherness, and excessive physical affection have sparked rumors that they’re dating.
The truth is, Katsumi secretly harbors romantic feelings for Minoru. It’s obvious that Minoru considers Katsumi special, but his affection is a confusing mix of familial love, friendship, and desire—something fundamentally different from romance.
Understanding this, Katsumi struggles to restrain himself, refusing to cross the line between friendship and something more.
However, their delicate balance is suddenly shattered one day—and everything changes…!?

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: エモーション・コントローラー
ヴァルナ・コレクション

189328.description:
Kaname is an ordinary high schooler who has a crush on his perfect classmate, Nobuharu, who is handsome, intelligent, and good at both academics and sports.
His daily routine is to watch over him (= stalk him).
One day, when he was happy just looking at him, Nobuharu said, "You might be my destined partner", and locked on to him, eating him!?
A carnivorous school prince who believes in fate x a devoted, crying, brave stalker. A heart-pounding, devoted high schooler love story.

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

Notes:
- Originally serialized under the title "Maicchingu Unmei (まいっちんぐ運命)".
- Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: 運命は覗き見してたらヤッてきた

189329.description:
Now that they’ve successfully made it back home safe and sound, Yogiri, Tomochika, and the surviving members of their class begin the long work of readjusting to life in their own world. But even with their story finished, countless mysteries remain to be explored! This collection of short stories answers all sorts of questions left unanswered by the main series. What was Hanakawa’s previous adventure like? Who is Haruto Ootori, and why does he have wings? Just what has (the real) Enju been up to since we last saw her in the underground facility? There are plenty of answers to be found in over ten stories...and maybe another mystery or two to ponder!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: My Instant Death Ability Is So Overpowered, No One in This Other World Stands a Chance Against Me! After Story
title.native: 即死チートが最強すぎて、異世界のやつらがまるで相手にならないんですが。〈後始末篇〉
title.romaji: Sokushi Cheat ga Saikyou Sugite, Isekai no Yatsura ga Marude Aite ni Naranai n desu ga. - Atoshimatsu-hen

title.native: 年下の女性教官に今日も叱っていただけた
title.romaji: Toshishita no Josei Kyoukan ni Kyou mo Shikatte Itadaketa

title.native: 君のガチ恋距離にいてもいいよね? ～クラスの人気アイドルと気ままな息抜きはじめました～
title.romaji: Kimi no Gachikoi Kyori ni Itemo Ii Yone?: Class no Ninki Idol to Kimamana Ikinuki Hajimemashita

189332.description: Just your plain average high school girl, getting involved in yuri shenanigans.

title.native: 地味なJKが美少女に○○される話
title.romaji: Jimi na JK ga Bishoujo ni ○○sareru Hanashi

title.native: 幼馴染とえっちで仲直り

189336.description:
Why not unwind in another world once in a while? High schooler Kudo Akira happens upon the ability to travel between Japan and the fantastical world of Do-Melta. Not bound by any dire mission or duty, he leisurely enjoys exploring his way through the massive dungeon in the center of the world and all the trappings that come with it. The guild receptionist is trying to mooch off of him, his magic instructor has “rewards” for him, and he just might have some fun with a girl he saves... A brand-new fantasy adventure from Hitsuji Gamei begins!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: After-School Dungeon Diver: Level Grinding in Another World
title.native: 放課後の迷宮冒険者～日本と異世界を行き来できるようになった僕はレベルアップに勤しみます～
title.romaji: Houkago no Dungeon Diver: Nihon to Isekai wo Ikiki Dekiru You ni Natta Boku wa Level Up ni Isoshimimasu

189337.description:
His sword is his last resort!!

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-02

189338.description:
Hayato, an alpha, has been grappling with a problem for years. That is, his older childhood friend and fated omega partner, Riichi, won't do anything more than kiss him due to the rule: "No excessive touching!"

Nine years ago, when Hayato was still a kid, he bit Riichi on the nape of the neck while they were roughhousing, accidentally making them a fated pair. As a result, Riichi made him promise not to cross a certain line with him until he turned 20. With one year left, Hayato is determined to get Riichi, who keeps treating him like a younger brother, to love him back. Unfortunately, all of his attempts have ended in failure... Or so he thinks! One day, when Hayato caresses Riichi gently with his hands, Riichi's reason begins to crumble...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
189338.hashtag: #しないしないもあいのうち
synonyms: Even Not Doing It Is a Form of Love

title.native: しないしないもあいのうち
title.romaji: Shinai Shinai mo Ai no Uchi

189339.description:
Kaito Irie—an unremarkable young man without even hobbies to speak of—has been killed thanks to a goddess’s careless mistake. As recompense, he is offered the chance to continue living in a new world with not just one newfound passion to guide and fulfill him, but three: “Collection,” “Animal Ears,” and “Laser Beams.” But with everything looking too good to be true, Kaito can’t help but wonder...is there a catch? Using his new god-given power to fire a beam powerful enough to smite any foe and precise enough to replace any tool, Kaito becomes an adventurer in search of riches and glory. Along the way, he tirelessly helps the oppressed, half-animal, half-human hybrids that inhabit his new home. Is it out of the goodness of his heart...or out of a desire to get closer to their irresistibly adorable animal ears?! Here unfolds the epic tale of a typical, run-of-the-mill guy who just happens to wield a peerless beam of death!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: From Desk Job to Death Beam: In Another World with My Almighty Lasers
title.native: 最強デスビームを撃てるサラリーマン、異世界を征く
title.romaji: Saikyou Death Beam wo Uteru Salaryman, Isekai wo Yuku: Ken to Mahou no Sekai wo Muteki no Beam de Musou suru

189341.description: Vampires are monsters that feed on human blood and replicate at the blink of an eye. When Zanki is bequeathed a cane from his grandfather, he takes up the role of a Vampire Slayer.
synonyms: The Tale of Zanki the Vampire Slayer

title.native: 斬吸血鬼譚 ザンキ

189342.description:
"That... sounds kinda nice."

Minami Chihiro has a rare condition—when exhaustion and stress pile up, he develops a fever... and goes into heat. Now in college, he reunites with his old classmate, Shishiou, who aggressively pursues him. Back in middle school, Shishiou once taught Chihiro how to jerk off, and to keep that a secret, Chihiro agreed to a deal: "I'll go on 10 dates with you."

Grocery shopping together, cooking meals, hanging out at cafés… Before he knows it, Chihiro finds himself getting swept up in Shishiou's pace—!?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

189348.description:
Born as the son of a wealthy family, Jang Geon was destined for ruin. To turn his fate around, he had to live a simple life under the guidance of a virtuous monk. Given to the frugal monk Gyeongmok at Shaolin Temple, Jang Geon spent his days in rough cotton robes, barely getting by on plain rice... While enduring hunger and minimizing movement in his daily life, he stumbled upon martial arts and managed to apply his mindset of thrift to it...?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

189349.description: Released at Sunshine Creation 2017 Winter, Comic Market 93.

189350.description:
Do you like intense girls?

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten 2025-02

189351.description:
Prince Callus Leditzweissen is a Taboo Being, an unfortunate soul born with a deadly curse that causes him constant suffering. With no known cure, the doctors say Callus only has six months left to live. But a magician named Gourley gives the boy a sliver of hope when he demonstrates the healing power of light magic. Callus is determined to learn how to use light magic in time to save himself, hoping to live longer to repay all the kindness he's been shown throughout his life.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: I Only Have Six Months to Live, So I’m Gonna Break the Curse with Light Magic or Die Trying
title.native: 余命半年と宣告されたので、死ぬ気で『光魔法』を覚えて呪いを解こうと思います。～呪われ王子のやり治し～
title.romaji: Yomei Hantoshi to Senkoku Sareta node, Shinuki de "Hikari Mahou" wo Oboete Noroi wo Hodokou to Omoimasu. Noroware Ouji no Yari Naoshi

189352.description:
The series follows genius surgeon Akira Kirihara, who is suddenly reborn as Chiara Bellworth, the protagonist of "Cinderella's Engagement." In this world, all wounds are healed by magic, and those whose injuries cannot be healed are abandoned. Kiara comes to the medical aid of Prince Cecil's follower. Impressed with her power, he proposes to her in hopes of reforming the country's medical system.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 外科医キアラは死亡フラグを許さない　～死人だらけのシナリオは、前世の知識で書きかえます～

189353.description:
Something's "up"... with this couple...??

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2025-02

title.english: I Won't Get It Unless You Spell It Out!
title.native: 「もー言わなきゃわかんないよ～」

189355.description:
There’s a price to be paid for a seemingly perfect life. For Raven, the dashing young son of a duke tasked with guarding the empire, marriage represents nothing but a downward spiral into misery. Cherishing his freedom as a bachelor, Raven is perplexed when the daughter of rival House Sharen makes him a daring proposal of marriage. But there’s a hitch: Lady Estrella Sharen is an infamous villainess who is feared across the empire! Raven suspects there is more to her than meets the eye, but nonetheless agrees to enter into a marriage contract…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: I can't stop doting on the most evil woman in the empire!

title.english: I've Fallen for the Empire's Greatest Villainess
title.native: 帝国一の悪女に溺愛がとまりません！
title.romaji: Teikoku Ichi no Akujo ni Dekiai ga Tomarimasen!

189356.description:
There’s a convenience store that feels uncomfortable but somehow keeps drawing you in. One day, a new night-shift part-timer appears at the small convenience store -- his rugged looks fill everyone with unease, but soon he brings about a refreshing change to this small convenience store. He helps not only his coworkers but also customers, resolving their worries and troubles. Who is this mysterious night-shift part-timer?

(Source: WEBTOON)

189357.description:
Gang-In Na wakes up in the year 2024 in the middle of South Korea with no memory of where or who he is. Upon hearing a voice that sounds strangely familiar, he comes face to face with a robot named ACE (Autonomous Combat Entity), who informs him that he was once part of the Earth Federation Forces in the year 2082 and possesses a wide array of skills. Gang-In decides to join forces with ACE to recover his lost memories and adapt to life on Earth, but the two look to be in for a bumpy ride.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: A Hero Who Does Everything Perfectly
A Hero Who Is Good At Everything

189358.description:
Monsters pour out of gates, wreaking havoc on the world, but Tae-Jun couldn’t care less. After seven years of failure and bullying in his hunter’s guild, he’s fired—until his dormant S-Tier power suddenly activates. Now, with newfound strength, Tae-Jun hunts monsters, exacts brutal revenge, and rises to fame. But as his power grows, so does the danger, and shadowy forces begin targeting him. Can Tae-Jun stay one step ahead and crush those who want him dead?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: My Status Window Is On Strike

title.english: My Status Window Went on Strike

189359.description:
"You guys use fists, not guns!"

Shin Hae-Soo, a specialist in excessive suppression, gains the ability to go back 60 minutes. On the day my father passed away, I intuitively knew. This was a murder disguised as suicide. Hae-Soo becomes a detective to catch the culprit who killed his father. And one day, along with a mysterious accident, he suddenly gains superpowers! A huge shadow gradually reveals itself as he solves criminal cases and pursues the organization!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

189360.description:
The academy where Amon was assigned as a new teacher has gone bankrupt! The principal is addicted to gambling, the teachers are no-goods, and the students are lethargic! How will Amon tread forth as he stands at the crossroads of escape and success? A comedic fantasy series that will make your sides hurt from laughing!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
synonyms: อะคาเดมีนี้เห็นทีจะเจ๊ง
廃校寸前のアカデミーに就職した

189361.description:
Seon-U Kang, a high school student, single-handedly takes down a group of illegal loan sharks who show up at his house. While being treated at the hospital, he encounters a mysterious man who offers him an invitation to a suspicious secret fighting tournament with a massive cash prize. The prize money is his only hope to save his family. Seon-U must survive in the combat ward at all costs! Will he be able to defeat all other fighters and become champion?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.native: エルフ王女は触手に抗えない
title.romaji: Elf Oujo wa Shokushu ni Aragaenai

189363.description:
I'll protect you... I'm your big sister, after all.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Shitsurakuten 2025-01

189364.description:
Ever since falling ill as a child, Mel Slofi has had white hair. However, this trait brings her more than she bargained for when it leads her to be mistaken for the lost daughter of a duke-- even being told by the duke’s son to keep up the facade in order to protect his fragile father. But when Mel sees a mysterious woman at a grand ball who perfectly matches the photos she’s seen of the duke’s real daughter, she begins to worry that the truth may be catching up to her.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The Day the Real One Appeared

title.native: 欠落錬金術師の異世界生活 ～転生したら魔力しか取り柄がなかったので錬金術を始めました～
title.romaji: Ketsuraku Renkinjutsushi no Isekai Seikatsu: Tensei Shitara Maryoku Shika Torie ga Nakatta node Renkinjutsu wo Hajimemashita

title.native: 異世界転生したら辺境伯令嬢だった～推しと共に生きる辺境生活～＠COMIC
title.romaji: Isekai Tensei Shitara Henkyou Haku Reijou Datta: Oshi to Tomo ni Ikiru Henkyou Seikatsu - @COMIC

title.native: シークレットアフター sparkle

189369.description:
Shino, an average office worker, somehow ended up dating Aoha, an ultra-rare SSS-rank Dom—practically an urban legend. With Aoha being a top model, syncing their schedules is tough, and they barely get to see each other. Living together would solve that… and maybe even lead to something more…? As Aoha’s overwhelming affection intensifies, their honeymoon phase only deepens their bond.

(Source: Taiyohtosho, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ブラットテイマー／キング engage!

189370.description:
On his first wedding anniversary, office worker Hiura returns home—only to walk in on his wife cheating.
What follows is a messy, drawn-out ordeal, but with the help of Sugaya, a former high school underclassman turned lawyer, the divorce is finalized.
Finally free, Hiura enjoys a long-overdue drink with Sugaya, but on the way home, he suddenly has a flashback and ends up throwing up. Unable to return to the scene of the betrayal, he’s been crashing at internet cafés, and to make matters worse, he awkwardly admits, "I... can't get it up anymore."
Concerned, Sugaya offers, "Why don’t you stay at my place?"—and from there, everything begins to change…

(Source: Leed Publishing, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: バッドルームセラピー

189371.description:
Izumi, a dedicated music student, worked tirelessly to get into a prestigious conservatory. But fate has a cruel sense of humor—his longtime rival, Yona, is now his classmate. Once the very person who defeated him in past competition, Yona is a prodigy, praised as a rising star on the international piano scene. Fueled by quiet resentment, Izumi seizes a chance to show off his skills during a lecture. To his surprise, instead of dismissing him, Yona makes an unexpected offer: "Be my duet partner." And so, their tumultuous campus life begins—!?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

189372.description:
Negura works at an app development company and absolutely hates his boss, Tai.
Tai is effortlessly competent, good-looking, and always seems to overshadow him, fueling Negura’s inferiority complex. But the most irritating thing of all? Tai’s secret—he's a top-ranked top on a dating app exclusively for men.
Unable to stop himself from imagining what his insufferable boss is like at night, Negura spends his days in frustrated turmoil.
One day, after a work blunder leaves him seething, Negura finally snaps and pins Tai down. Seeing his usually composed boss flushed with shame and pleasure… he can’t hold back his excitement!

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: マッチングリバーサルメーカー
