189374.description:
Kei, a soccer player who cracks under pressure, encounters... a lively severed samurai head!? Get ready for a heartwarming comedy about a boy helping a headless samurai find peace in the afterlife!

(Source: Manga Plus)

synonyms: I'm singing above the cloud, waiting for you

title.native: 雲上に歌いて、君を待つ。
title.romaji: Unjou ni Utaite, Kimi wo Matsu

189378.description:
In a world torn between light and darkness, Juniper, a lowly soldier in the Demon King's army, receives an impossible task. To mentor the fallen hero! As an unlikely bond forms between them, their connection may reshape the very fabric of their divided realm. An epic high fantasy adventure where heaven and earth collide!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189379.description:
Welcome to "Octet," the one and only host club in Nara Prefecture... but this is no ordinary establishment! Their clientele? None other than goddesses themselves! Experience a modern-day host club fantasy like no other!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189380.description:
The world has ended. I was a genius hero, but my efforts were too little, too late—I couldn’t stop the Blood Demon Emperor. As I died, I prayed for a second chance... but this isn't what I meant! Of all people, I’ve become Christian, a rogue member of the House of Dark Demons. As if that wasn’t enough, the world is still ending in just five years. There's only one way to save it: I must become the emperor myself and stop the war! I know it sounds ridiculous, but I’m a genius—I can make it work!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Became the Genius Bastard of a Noble Dark Clan

title.english: The Unorthodox Genius of the House of Darkness

189381.description:
Akira is eager to get laid, but he doesn't want a boyfriend nor does he want to do it with a complete stranger. One day, when he tries to break things off with his no-strings-attached partner who developed romantic feelings for him, the guy desperately clings onto him in public, begging him not to leave. Coincidentally, Akira's former student from back when he was a student teacher sees him in trouble and saves the day! Akira is thrilled to be reunited with Tadayasu, who's as good-looking as Akira remembers him in high school, and convinces him, rather forcibly, to stay the night at his house... The more Akira gets to know Tadayasu, the more he becomes infatuated with the charming younger straight guy! However, Akira is reluctant to make a move on Tadayasu, who's technically still in his teens... So, can he hurry up and grow up already!?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter
189381.hashtag: #あともうすこしで恋なのに！
synonyms: Just a Little More, and It Would Be Love!

title.native: あともうすこしで恋なのに！
title.romaji: Ato Mou Sukoshi de Koi Nanoni!

189382.description:
Yeong-won, who once again failed to secure a full professorship, gets drunk in a fit of rage and ends up sleeping with Ui-hyeon, her closest friend. Yeong-won soon discovers that she can only escape the pressure of her professorship when having sex. She then spends a passionate night with her colleague, Louis, who suggests that Yeong-won use Ui-hyeon for a...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

189384.description:
With her beauty, power, and the position of empress, Vionne Rosa Ellient seemingly had everything one could want. But in truth, she endlessly yearned for love before ultimately dying in misery. Now, after waking up again as her younger self, Vionne calmly assesses her situation and past memories to avoid marrying Crown Prince Sirius and meeting the same fate. As different choices lead to a change in relationships and a turn of events, will Vionne prevent this life from being another tragedy?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Life Was but a Play

title.native: 瞳の中の僕を知らない
title.romaji: Hitomi no Naka no Boku wo Shiranai

189386.description:
"What should I do…? I think I’ve fallen for him…!!"

Kaoru, an honor student, is asked by his teacher to help tutor Shinta, a troubled student who rarely attends school. Reluctantly agreeing just to earn some extra credit, Kaoru expects resistance—but to his surprise, Shinta, despite his initial defiance, turns out to be unexpectedly obedient. And when praised, his reactions are adorably cute…!?

Unaccustomed to receiving compliments, Shinta even tries his best at the naughty challenges Kaoru jokingly teases him with.

Completely caught off guard by Shinta’s unexpected sweet side, Kaoru finds himself unable to stop his heart from racing—but what happens next…!?

(Source: KiR comics, translated)

title.native: 俺の可愛い、褒められたがりくん

189387.description:
Kento, a weary office worker, meets Sora, a construction worker, at a small candy shop. Sora’s friendly smile and comforting presence gradually soothe Kento, leading him to visit the shop more often and become increasingly aware of Sora. Then, one day, when Sora catches him just as he’s about to fall, the strength and warmth of his embrace unexpectedly send a reaction through Kento’s lower body…!?

A deeply sweet love story between a cheerful, muscular man and an exhausted salaryman!

(Source: Shinshokan, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.
synonyms: This Love is Surely Too Sweet

title.native: この恋はきっと、甘すぎる

189388.description:
“I have erectile dysfunction.”

Not exactly the kind of confession Woo Hyeon-Woo ever planned to make, but a few too many drinks later, his biggest secret slips out to his classmate Ha Jeong-Yoon. Mortified, Hyeon-Soo braces for pity or laughter… but Jeong-Yoon just grins.

“Then why don’t we test it out? Who knows? Maybe I can fix you.”

Wait, what?! Before Hyeon-Soo can process what’s happening, he’s suddenly part of Jeong-Yoon’s “scientific experiment.” What started as drunken honesty turns into a very hands-on test of chemistry, curiosity, and terrible decisions. Now, every accidental touch feels like a loaded dice roll. Will it be a total flop, or a nat 20? Caught between panic and possibility, Hyeon-Soo wonders if maybe, just maybe, his biggest problem wasn’t physical after all…

Because with Jeong-Yoon around, something else is definitely ""rising"" to the occasion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189389.description:
Back in high school, Hyeon Ji-Woo was the ace of the legendary Seongeon High baseball team—and secretly dating his younger teammate, Choi Seon-Ho. But their sweet first love came to an abrupt end when Seon-Ho suddenly left for the U.S., breaking up with Ji-Woo without warning. Fast forward 10 years: Ji-Woo has buried all his desires and emotions under a mountain of work, living a quiet, no-nonsense life… until Seon-Ho shows up again. Not as a successful returnee or old flame, but as a temp worker—causing a scene with a bottle of whiskey in hand! Cue the chaos: awkward reunions, unresolved tension, and one very confused adult trying not to fall all over again. He was Ji-Woo’s first love, first heartbreak… and possibly, his newest headache.

Is this a second chance at love—or just a second round of disaster?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: ゼロセンチメートル〜10年ぶりに再会した初恋のあいつ〜

189390.description:
From childhood, Sohm has always felt queasy and unsettled whenever he looks at Geon, a boy who is almost like him but somehow completely different. The two can never meet eyes without arguing, and when their parents remarry and they suddenly become family, strict rules are put in place to keep the peace. Rule One: Go to and from school together. Rule Two: Hug for thirty full seconds before entering the house. Forced into daily embraces, their unwanted closeness begins to change in ways neither expected. Geon’s teasing eventually leads to something far more risky than bickering, and the two find themselves sharing more than they had ever intended...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19

189391.description:
Viola, the daughter of a declining count (she was Japanese in her previous life), was married off to Albert―the next duke―by her parents. However, on the very first night of their marriage, her husband declares, “All I ask of you is that you carry out your role as the wife of the duke in appearance only,” effectively shattering any hope of a romantic relationship.

Despite the soul-destroying statement from him, Viola picks up the pieces and starts to live happily and without restraints, announcing, “Forget my ice-cold, rude husband. I'm gonna live my life the way I want!” However, her new husband and mansion seem to hide a secret...?! It's a smothering romance of a reincarnated, happy-go-lucky lady who, by comforting the traumatized husband, turns him into the most doting of husbands♡

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: My Ice-Rose Husband Said He Only Wants Me to Play the Role of the Next Duchess, but Now He's Stalking Me at Home!
title.native: 次期公爵夫人の役割だけを求めてきた、氷の薔薇と謳われる旦那様が家庭内ストーカーと化した件
title.romaji: Jiki Koushaku Fujin no Yakuwari Dake wo Motomete Kita, Koori no Bara to Utawareru Danna-sama ga Kateinai Stalker to Kashita Ken

189392.description:
A special collaboration between Satosumi Takaguchi, Miwa Sakai, and Emiko Yachi! (And special guests)
The year is 1962, world famous Hollywood actress M.M. has passed away, and its rumoured that her diary contained dirty secrets about very important politicians....

This special collaboration was planned and organized by Satosumi Takaguchi to commemorate Miwa Sakai going freelance, with all contributors drawing one "cast member" each

189394.description:
Due to family circumstances, Nagi was separated from his beloved childhood friend, Kazuma. However, they unexpectedly reunite in high school.

During their time apart, Nagi had completely transformed into a delinquent. But in front of his dearest Kazuma, he can’t help but turn into a lovestruck, sweet mess!?

Despite shocking their classmates with his drastic personality shift (which only happens around Kazuma), neither of them realizes their true feelings. They continue spending their days together in an affectionate yet oblivious relationship...

Find your hidden talent and grow into an idol, Play hard to get with the System that doesn't listen well/be disobedient, Figure out the past of the transmigrated character/character you've transmigrated to. Without money, a home, or any knowledge, I went through all sorts of hardships, but…

After their wedding, she begins to dream of sharing intimate nights with Cedric, leaving her caught between the boundaries of reality and illusion. Are these just dreams, or could they be something more? Once again, she closes her eyes, completely unaware of the truth.

Sierra's peaceful village life is disrupted when her ex-boyfriend, Duke Cassius Ideos, shows up and mistakes the child she's raising as his daughter. The thing is, the girl is her niece, not her kid! When he refuses to listen to any explanation, her only option is to follow him to his duchy and await the results of a paternity test. All Sierra has to do is keep to herself for three months, but will things remain that simple when she begins to suspect that the duke still has feelings for her?

Takahashi pushes Fukaya to confess not wanting him to regret it later, but turns out, the person he likes is actually... me!

They meet at a movie theater and hit it off quickly, going out for a drink afterwards to discuss the movie they saw. From there, things escalate to kissing and eventually they end up in a hotel room. In a tragic twist, an accidental injury inflicted by Yi-Ryeong on Geom-Mu leads to her being sentenced to death. The Empress Dowager decrees that the only cure for the Emperor’s affliction is for him to consummate with Yi-Ryeong. Welcome to back to TruthTalk TV, a channel dedicated to solving relationship problems from around the country! Our latest submission comes from a Joo Do-Hee, young woman torn between her ex and her childhood best friend. She writes: “Dear TruthTalk TV, my ex and I ended our four-year relationship because he couldn’t keep up with me in the bedroom. So, I drunkenly slept with my best friend one night, and it was everything I ever could have hoped for! The only problem? "He's always had such a creepy smile. I can never tell what he's thinking about. I absolutely refuse to marry someone like that!" That's what she always thought, but... her parents forced to live with Masaomi!?

Though troubled by the sudden cohabitation, she gradually comes to learn of the considerate Masaomi's kindness and earnestness... A story of misunderstanding, between a girl who is afraid of romance and a high-spec heir!

(Source: Azuki)

title.english: I Got Married to a Man I Can't Stand
title.native: 嫌いなヤツと夫婦になりまして
title.romaji: Kirai na Yatsu to Fuufu ni Narimashite

189603.description:
Misaki is a young woman who scores everything with points and loves to one-up others. Upon reuniting with a woman that she used to look down on as a child, the foundations of her vain, 120-point life begin to crack…

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: だってワタシ、120点だもの。

189604.description:
"Can you sell it to me for 10,000 dollars?" A secret that should have stayed hidden was lying in the illegally taken nude video…

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: 盗ミ撮リ～あの娘の秘密､覗きます
title.romaji: Toumitori: Ano Musume no Himitsu, Nozokimasu

189605.description:
"Okay, shall we do it...?" Hands on practice is a must for becoming a hentai manga artist! With every lewd class in hentai manga artist school seducing me more and more, will I be able to control myself...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Hentai Manga School! ~I'm the Only Guy?!~
title.native: えろまんっ！～エロマンガ専門学校に男は僕だけ!?～
title.romaji: Eroman!: Ero Manga Senmon Gakkou ni Otoko wa Boku dake!?

189606.description: Chika Suzugamori and her traveling companions solve mysteries and go on day trips!

189607.description:
While these cute schoolgirls may protect Japan as agents of Lycoris, they're also coffee shop employees. Chisato embarks on even more thrilling adventures at Café LycoReco. Meanwhile, Takina awakens in a cabin in the woods with a murderer?! And what do Fuki and Sakura have going on, besides protecting the city without anyone knowing? The everyday lives of these girls are anything but normal!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: リコリス･リコイル Recovery days

189608.description:
"I'll give you an unforgettable first experience as a present." Her body burning from being forcefully aroused because of an aphrodisiac she was given mouth-to-mouth... Momo used to dream of a bright future with her fiance. However one day, her house was set on fire and she was abducted by a man named Kibagami, who is apparently her father's boss. "Starting today, you're my wife. I'll take good care of you." Unable to understand his intentions, Momo resists desperately, but because of the aphrodisiac and his relentless caresses, her whole body melts... What's happening to me? I hate this, but it's making me crazy...!!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Simultaneously released in long-strip and traditional formats, with 15 episodes and 5 chapters respectively.

title.english: Mansion of Love Thorns ~Aphrodisiac-Dripping First Experience~
title.native: 愛棘の館～初夜は媚薬で濡れおちる～
title.romaji: Ai Toge no Kan: Shoya wa Biyaku de Nure Ochiru

189609.description:
Cosette lived a poor life alongside her mother.
One day, she finds out she was born to a Count as his hidden child.
To get revenge on this nobleman who harmed her mother, Cosette disguises herself as a boy named "Gilbert" and declares she will become the heir to the Count's family, aiming to become the perfect noble child while hiding her gender.
But one day, at a ball, the gentleman Wolff discovers that she's a woman, pulling her into the nobles' waves of malice. Will Cosette be able to successfully exact her revenge?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.native: 偽りの薔薇は復讐に染まる
title.romaji: Itsuwari no Bara wa Fukushuu ni Somaru

189610.description:
Natalie is a wedding planner who doesn't believe in love. As she's coordinating a wedding for her good friend, she reunites with Colin, who has become a wealthy businessman, for the first time in fourteen years. He holds a special place in her memories as her first crush. Taken with his warm, dazzling smile, she invites him out to dinner, only to be promptly refused! However, several days later Colin requests that she plan his younger sister's wedding. But this time, why is he the one who is pursuing her?

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 大富豪に拒まれた初恋

189611.description:
It's Gretchen's job to make sure weddings go flawlessly, but this time she's received a special request-Gretchen is to pretend to be lovers with movie star Julian Cooper during the wedding ceremony! Her ample figure and frizzy hair don't look like the Hollywood dream, though, so how can she pull it off? When she meets the gorgeous Julian, he immediately notices that she's a little stiff and decides she needs "acting lessons." So he gives her a sweet kiss! Her next stops are high-end boutiques and a luxurious spa-she won't be the same woman when this job is done!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: One Week With the Best Man

189612.description:
Momiji, a daughter with dreams of being a swordswoman, has been thrust into an arranged marriage with a prestigious earl she has never met.
Soon after, she agrees to a match with Shuichiro, a senior dojo student, betting that if she loses, he can do whatever he wants with her. But after her defeat, he sweetly claims his prize by taking her virginity?!
Trying to escape this marriage, Momiji ends up falling right into the deceiving earl's trap...!
The start of a sweet and steamy Taisho Era romance where both this tomboy's mind and body are at the mercy of this earl's captivating charm!!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: The Deceiving Earl's Sheltered Princess: A Romance Guide for Girls in Taisho Era
title.native: ペテン伯爵の囲われ姫～大正ヲトメ恋術指南～
title.romaji: Peten Hakushaku no Kakowarehime: Taisho Otome Renjitsu Shinan

title.native: 今まで一度も女扱いされたことがない女騎士を女扱いする漫画
title.romaji: Ima made Ichido mo Onna Atsukaisareta Koto ga nai Jokishi wo Onna Atsukai Suru

189614.description:
The time is the Taisho era. Kiyoko, the eldest daughter of the former aristocratic Ichiji family, is beautiful, but because of a birthmark on her face, she is compared to her younger sister and treated like a servant by her family. Hoping to change her fate, she goes to an arranged marriage meeting, but her partner, Sakuya, is blind...!?

(Source: mechacomic, translated)

title.native: 朧の花嫁～かりそめの婚約は、青く、甘く～
title.romaji: Oboru no Hanayome: Karisome no Konyaku wa, Aoku, Amaku

title.native: ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！×おでかけ子ザメ アニメジャパンコラボまんが
title.romaji: Bocchi the Rock! × Odekake Kozame Anime Japan Collab Manga

189616.description:
After school as usual, Naruyuki is tutoring Fumino in the library. Suddenly, a famous detective from a different era appears...?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

title.native: ぼくたちは勉強ができない 特別編
title.romaji: Bokutachi wa Benkyou ga Dekinai: Tokubetsu-hen

189617.description:
Ever since she was a child, Tsubaki's scarlet eyes have held a mysterious power that caused those around her to shun her. Despite this, she tried to live a quiet life, but her cousin, Kiyona, spread rumors about her "cursed" power and had her imprisoned. When plans to sell her are set in motion, Tsubaki steels herself and escapes. Prepared to throw her life away, she is unexpectedly rescued by Kyo, the heir to a distinguished family. Upon learning of the plot to sell her, Kyo decides to purchase her himself, as his night attendant. Tsubaki believes her life is over, but Kyo's unexpected kindness begins to change her world, little by little.

(Source: Manga Plaza )

title.english: Romance in Bloom: Taken in as a Night Attendant but Loved Dearly
title.native: 華に浪漫～夜伽のはずですが溺愛されています～
title.romaji: Hana ni Roman: Yotogi no Hazu desu ga Dekiai Sarete Imasu

189618.description:
Ravaged by a powerful demon that comes to him every night, Count Erwar del Diav has been enduring the pains and pleasures of their relationship in silence. His despair deepens when he learns this is the consequence of a curse placed on him by an unknown person. Meanwhile, Erwar’s powerful yet possessive friend, Grand Duke Kaijack, arrives at the Diav Estate to take Erwar back to the capital. Although he longs to escape the clutches of his friend and the demon, Erwar can do little to gain his freedom. And yet, everything is also not as it seems...

(Source: Tappytoon)

189619.description:
Skylar has to go back to school with the help of her bodyguard, Nathan. As the daughter of the gangster boss, will she be able to fit in?

(Source: Toomics)

title.native: 初恋。-世界にはまだひみつ-
title.romaji: Hatsukoi.: Sekai ni wa Mada Himitsu

189622.description: A feisty girl isn't too fond of her childhood friend being so fixated on doing manga with others.

189623.description:
Myung-Sun lives for lazy days, dating apps, and dodging work at his family’s BBQ joint. He’s on the hunt for a buff guy to fulfill his fantasies—so when a ripped part-timer appears, it feels like fate. But when they both turn out to be tops, things start getting heated!

(Source: Manta)

189624.description:
"If you're going to say you're sorry, act like you really mean it. Didn't you say you'll do anything?" Han Zaizhou arrogantly told the man who was trying to apologize. Lu Heliu wasn't expecting forgiveness, but if he could do something to ease the other man's pain, he is willing to do whatever it takes.

"Anything you want."

"Then you'll do whatever I want. Until I am satisfied."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Is It Too Late to Apologize?

189625.description:
By aiming for good deeds, it seems she has entered the Prince's doting route!? Countess Louise, who for some reason can see letters above people's heads, is trying to change the "villainous lady (ruined)" that comes to her mind and become a virtuous lady! However, when confronted by Sylvie, she honestly tells him the letters "Target, Second Prince (easy)", which sparks her interest and they become engaged. Furthermore, he promises to "change the letters to put your mind at ease"...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 私の上に浮かぶ『悪役令嬢(破滅する)』って何でしょうか?
title.romaji: Watashi no Ueni Ukabu "Akuyaku Reijou (Hametsu suru)" tte Nani Deshou ka?

189626.description:
Zhong Shen is a young member of the Zhong family tasked with subduing demons roaming the human realm. However, he is only an illegitimate disciple who can only cultivate at the lowest level. In a world on the brink of war, Shen must prepare himself to fulfill his mother's last wish.

(Source: INKR)

189627.description:
"Cheong-Un, parry the attack! Move faster or the obstacle course will kill you!”

The progenitors of the great Wudang sect and the mighty Shaolin encounter post-ascension issues when they find themselves reduced to servants in the godly realm. Their only hope and escape from their divine chores lie in the hands of less-than-average Cheong-Un, who can hardly beat his peers in the sect. Can the masters raise an average boy into a master of martial arts and finally relieve themselves of their menial chores?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: The Masters Are Watching Over Me
The Masters Are Subscribing to Me

189629.description:
A story about the bitter-sweet romance (mind control) between a teacher and his students.

(Source: DLsite)

Note: Released at COMITIA151
synonyms: Fuck Film Featuring A Deranged Teacher & His Mind-Controlled Students

title.native: 某都立C学に、教え子マインドコントロールしてハメ撮りしまくってた頭バグってる教師がいたらしい
title.romaji: Bou Toritsu C Gaku ni, Oshiego Mind Control shite Hamedori Shimakutteta Atama Bugtteru Kyoushi ga Itarashii

189630.description:
Duke Dubless has been scorned by all who meet him: the villainess, the protagonist, even the author of his story. But when a woman from the real world transmigrates into the novel as the duke's sworn knight, she swears to protect her favorite character from any and all threats be they physical or emotional. Can Jane make good on her knightly duties and protect her fave from attacks on all sides?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: อย่ามายุ่งกับสุดที่รักของฉัน

title.english: Don't Mess With My Duke Dubless!

title.native: 妻蜜ねぶり ～蒸れた柔肌に恋して…～
title.romaji: Tsumamitsu Neburi: Mureta Yawahada ni  Koishite...

synonyms: A Succubus Just Want to Fall in Love

title.native: あくまでも恋愛〈こい〉がしたい!

189634.description:
Oh Seung-Pyo has always been at the top of his class, but once he enters high school, his spot gets stolen by Ryu Jae-Min. No matter how hard Seung-Pyo tries, he can't seem to reclaim his place and is stuck in second. For the first time in his life, he develops an inferiority complex and, without realizing it, he starts keeping an eye on Jae-Min. One rainy day, the two accidentally swap phones. Though it seemed like a minor accident, what Seung-Pyo discovers on Jae-Min's phone leaves him in shock, complicating their relationship beyond expectation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189635.description:
The Party of Heroes defeats the Demon King, a menace to the world. But as the enemy meets his demise, he unleashes miasma capable of destroying the entire world. In the face of despair, Saint Sophia makes the ultimate sacrifice to halt this devastating miasma. Years roll by, and when she finally awakens, she finds herself in a world twenty years into the future.

(Source: K MANGA)

Notes:
- In the original serialization, Chapter 2 was split into three parts while Chapters 3 to 33 were split into two parts. These were all combined in the volume releases.
- Includes five extra chapters.

title.english: The Awakening of a Great Saint: Waking up as a Legendary Great Saint after Twenty Years of Miasma Purification
title.native: 転生大聖女の目覚め～瘴気を浄化し続けること二十年、起きたら伝説の大聖女になってました～
title.romaji: Tensei Daiseijo no Mezame: Shouki wo Joukashitsuzukeru Koto ni Juunen, Okitara Densetsu no Daiseijo ni Nattemashita

title.native: 甘く淫らな小説家先生～秘めた情熱に溶かされて～
title.romaji: Amaku Midara na Shousetsu-ka Sensei: Himeta Jounetsu ni Tokasarete

189638.description:
Kyousuke and Kai are two up-and-coming musicians. However, the day before their big debut, Kai passes away in a terrible traffic accident. Three years later, Kyousuke has all but given up music when his supposedly deceased partner appears before him as if nothing happened. Kai reminds his friend of the magic of music, encouraging him to start playing again. Can Kyousuke overcome his past and bring the color back into his world once more?

(Source: Yen Press)

189639.description:
The story of a struggling young artist who, despite training under a respected master, begins to lose confidence in his work and considers giving up.

His perspective shifts when he meets a bold and talented newcomer who declares his ambition to make history and quickly proves his skill. Though initially discouraged, the encounter reignites the young artist’s passion and drive to face his art once more.

title.native: ガセン -明治大正画仙譚-

189640.description: The story starts with a man who, after losing his parents and being buried in debt, gets a job as a servant at a large mansion. There, he's punished by the young lady of the house—a painful experience he can’t forget, which slowly turns into a deep obsession. In a family that makes a living by getting rid of spirits, a strange and hauntingly beautiful tale begins to unfold.

title.native: 愛執ロマンティシズム

189641.description: Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

title.native: #えあかつ 無名絵師からの絵垢活動記
title.romaji: #Eakatsu: Mumei Eshi kara no Eaka Katsudouki

189642.description:
"I will follow my lady anywhere!"
A cross-dressing yuri rom-com about an overprotective maid × a clumsy young lady.

(Source: Hana to Yume, translated).

Note: Originally a one-shot published in Hana to Yume issue 9/2025, it was picked up for continuing serialization on 2025-06-05.

title.native: 男装メイドは尽くしたい

189643.description:
Love blossoms…

Now lovers, Ibu accompanies Okitsu back to Tokyo, where he uses his uncanny mind-reading ability to reexplore the mystery of Okitsu’s troubled past, returning to the site of the traumatic kidnapping. The revelations they discover should drive them closer together, but upon returning home, a cold distance seems to grow. Okitsu may not be able to read minds, but will he be able to follow his heart when times get tough?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

1-3. Luminescence Line (ルミネセンスライン)
4-5. Memoria Pandora (メモリアパンドラ)
6. Sense of Wonder (センスオブワンダー)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

189645.description:
Makishima Yutaro is told by Asaki Seiichi, a popular guy from the soccer club, "We're a man short, so I just went ahead and included you in this mixer." Furthermore, it turns out that everyone else at the mixer already had a girl he's interested in, so Yutaro is told to take care of the remaining unclaimed woman. But that "remaining" college girl turns out to be Kiraboshi Ayane, the former leader of a wildly popular idol group!? Yutaro's life takes a dramatic turn when he gets together with Kiraboshi Ayane, the former idol who is cute enough to be called a "national treasure."

(Source: PASH! Books, translated)
synonyms: I Ended Up Taking Home a Nationally Treasured Former Idol Beauty Who Was the Leftover at the Mixer I Was Forced Into

title.native: 人数合わせで合コンに参加した俺は、なぜか余り物になってた元人気アイドルで国宝級の美少女をお持ち帰りしました。
title.romaji: Ninzuu Awase de Goukon ni Sanka Shita Ore wa, Naze ka Amari Mono ni Natteta Moto Ninki Idol de Kokuhou-kyuu no Bishoujo wo Omotchikaeri Shimashita.

189646.description:
"Why can't we be together?" A fantasy x girls' love story about the meeting and separation of a mermaid and a human girl. Ito Kira's first yuri work.

(source: Twitter, translated)
synonyms: Falling in Love with a Mermaid and Turning Into Bubbles

title.native: 人魚に恋して泡になる
title.romaji: Ningyo ni Koishite Awa ni Naru

189647.description:
The mysterious game God’s Forsaken has descended upon Earth. In this world, players can gain lifespan by slaying monsters—and even better, they can expend that lifespan to manifest their in-game powers into reality! As supernatural abilities awaken, global chaos and disasters follow in their wake. In his previous life, Qin Feng fought tooth and nail to protect his sister, Qin Xiaoyou, eventually rising to become one of the top 100 powerhouses in the world. However, his devotion was met with the ultimate betrayal. Blinded by her obsession with a celebrity idol, his own sister gouged out his eyes to steal his "Ancient God’s Eyeballs" as a gift for her star. Now, reborn and sent back to the very beginning, Qin Feng has returned. This time, he will trust no one. Embracing the darkness, he chooses to walk the path of a god-tier assassin to become the strongest—alone!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: God-Level Assassin, I Am the Shadow
最強ジョブ暗殺者のやり直し

title.english: God-Tier Assassin: I Am the Shadow
title.native: 网游：神级刺客，我即是暗影
title.romaji: Wangyou: Shen Ji Cike, Wo Ji Shi Anying

title.native: お兄ちゃんは究極アイドル
ティンクル・ティンクル・ティンクル

189650.description:
After transmigrating to another world as a wealthy young master, Su Changqing only wanted to live a low-profile life as a rich second-generation heir and enjoy his days in comfort. However, his plans are suddenly disrupted when his family faces an unexpected crisis, and he accidentally discovers the Emperor's secret - that she is actually a woman.

While he initially feared the female Emperor would stop at nothing to silence him, to his surprise, she instead becomes interested in his mysterious ability to transform his appearance. She wants him to become her male body double. What Su Changqing never expected was that being the female Emperor's male substitute would mean he has to visit the imperial harem on his very first day. His peaceful life completely falls apart from that moment on...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: Breaking Into the Body of the Emperor's Daughter

title.native: #カワイイ死ね #そして君にさよならを告ぐ
title.romaji: #Kawaii Shine: #Shoshite Kimi ni Sayonara wo Tsugu

189652.description: This book is a 2012 entry in Shueisha’s “World Legends” educational Manga series. It tells the story of decorated Hungarian-American war photographer Robert Capa
synonyms: Learning manga world biography NEXT Robert Capa
学習漫画 世界の伝記 NEXT

title.native: ロバート・キャパ 戦争の悲惨さを最前線で写したプロカメラマン
title.romaji: Robert Capa: Sensou no Hisan-sa wo Saizen-sen de Utsushita Pro Cameraman

189653.description:
Igusa, a young guy obsessed with all things "evil," gets reincarnated as the very Demon Lord he's always admired—only to end up in a seriously rough situation. The new world he's reborn into has been wrecked by an interstellar war, leaving both swords and magic in decline! He finally becomes the Demon Lord, but the planet he was supposed to conquer? Yeah, it's already on the verge of collapse... That's when a girl calling herself a "Hero" and a beast-eared girl from another world show up. Without hesitation, Igusa forces them into his ranks, grinning like a true villain. No land left to conquer? No problem. He'll just take over the entire universe! Wielding cheat-level skills and magic, he commandeers a crashed warship and sets off into the vast reaches of space alongside his tamed(?) companions. All for the sake of his aesthetic of evil! So begins an otherworldly tale of shadows and schemes, where a man and the girls bound to him charge headlong and single-mindedly down the path of evil!

(Source: TO Books, translated)
synonyms: The Demon King and the Hero Became Out of Time

title.native: 魔王と勇者が時代遅れになりました@COMIC
title.romaji: Maou to Yuusha ga Jidai Okure ni Narimashita @COMIC

title.native: あさがおのポートレート

189656.description:
A woman who runs an accessory shop has been struggling with insomnia and her complicated relationship with her childhood friend, a perfumer. But then, something happens that could change their relationship.

(Source: Gekkan Princess, translated)

title.native: ファントムルース～魔女が夢見た最後の楽園～
title.romaji: Phantom Loose: Majo ga Yumemita Saigo no Rakuen

189657.description:
A cozy story about sisterhood and tasty food, following Yuzu (Yuzuki), a college student, and Suzu (Suzuhara), a grad student. When Suzu injures her hand, she asks Yuzu for help, but Suzu’s genius-like nature and carefree attitude leave Yuzu feeling completely drained. Feeling like she's the only one being dragged around, Yuzu strikes back by feeding piping hot oden to the injured Suzu. From there, the relationship between the two begins to evolve.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: すずとゆず 2人でお出かけ
title.romaji: Suzu to Yuzu Futari de Odekake

189658.description:
Xiao Nan died tragically and then isekai-ed to the 21st Continent. Although reborn as useless trash, he awakened the reverse system, and his strength would increase as long as he was hurt. What he didn’t know was that he had a hidden identity-as the chosen son of heaven who was prophesized to revitalize the Sword sect. The elders of all factions in the sect therefore hid their identities and approached Xiao Nan to try to recruit him into their own ranks. Since then, Xiao Nan began to enjoy being nurtured by beautiful female masters, whilst discovering features of the system to become stronger + start a harem.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Esteemed Female Masters All Want to Possess Me

title.romaji: Nü Shi Zunmen Dou Xiang Zhanyou Wo

189659.description:
Qi Yu was an ordinary boy with "one rune" who both went to school and worked to support his little sister. His life was difficult, but he's still optimistic.

One day, he was attacked by monster and was saved by a mysterious girl. At the critical moment, the "rune" on Qi Yu's forehead turned into a vertical eye, resonating with the girl's "rune." He was able to ultilize her power, enhance it and defeat the monster.

After that battle, Qi Yu's life completely changed with his new mysterious power and companions.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Fused With The Goddess To Evolve
I Merged With the Goddess and Evolved Chapter

189662.description:
Laura Highen needs a way to support her siblings and hears that House Cuvershaiden is hiring... except that the manor is haunted! Tempted by Duke Cuvershaiden's lucrative offer, Laura takes the job anyway. Who knows, with her ability to see ghosts, perhaps she can be of service!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Got a Job at a Haunted Mansion

title.english: The Ghostly Grind at Cuvershaiden Manor

189664.description:
Ji-u Shin has been transported into her own dating game. Her life inside the game is now being broadcast live across the cosmos. If she wants the broadcast to end, she must win the game. The catch? The game is set to the hardest difficulty, and she’s been cast as the notorious villainess, Theresa. If she fails to win, she will lose her life. Can she avoid all of Theresa’s bad endings and bring this broadcast to an end once and for all?

(Source: WEBTOON)

189666.description:
Seven scary and funny nightmares from the Queen of Horror, Kanako Inuki!

1. Ushirogami (うしろ神)
2. Psycho Box (サイコ・ボックス)
3. Children, Don't Play with Ghosts! (霊と遊ぶな子供たち!!)
4. Women of the Dark (暗闇の女たち)
4.1. Room 1: Woman that Loves Cooking (１号室　料理好きの女)
4.2. Room 2: Women in the Trash Dumping Area (２号室　ゴミ置き場の女たち)
4.3. Room 3: 117th Woman (３号室　117の女)
5. The House of Cockroaches (ゴキブリの家)
6. Nightmare Door (悪夢の扉)
7. 100 Ghost Stories (ふたつめの扉)

189667.description:
The nation's buzzing about Ahn Su-Ho, the newly awakened player who's giving up a life of riches to become a civil servant. They don't realize that Su-Ho's been a civil servant before... in his past life before he was killed by his own team! Now, Su-Ho's out to save the country from the worst of its criminal scum by gaining the strength to stop them before they can strike. Can Su-Ho power up and protect the nation, even if it means starting over completely? Or will justice be thwarted once more?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Return of the Sword God-Rank Civil Servant
剣聖公務員の返り咲き

title.english: The Civil Servant of the Sword Returns

189668.hashtag: #フェアプレイ・フェアラバーズ

title.native: フェアプレイ・フェアラバーズ

An island of gemstones and magical beasts floats in the sky...
On this island lives a kind and powerful demon king, Kougyoku.

Some forty years ago, Kougyoku used his magic to restore a stillborn griffin egg to life, and that griffin became his dearest companion, Topaz. In the years that followed, Topaz found that his love for Kougyoku had grown into something deeper than that of a beast's love for his king... and unbeknownst to him, Kougyoku had begun to feel the same.

Now, as Kougyoku struggles to summon the magic needed to restore his island, he is torn between his love for Topaz and his duty as king. And as his beloved finds himself faced with an impossible decision, Topaz is left with no choice but to decide their fates for him, even should it break his king's heart...!

A man who has everything and yet nothing. Remembering with regret how she once ignored Diana's mistreatment in the orphanage, she vows to protect her until her family finds her. The two grow close, and she sees her life unfolding in an unexpected way as she is welcomed into House Ellad with Diana. Will Lia find happiness in her second life, surrounded by love she's never known?

189683.description:
Cordelia, daughter of a countess, can’t seem to get married–mostly because her little sister Priscilla keeps stealing the hearts of her suitors. Ready to resign herself to a spinster fate, Cordelia is surprised when a handsome man suddenly courts her–and he’s a prince, no less! Prince Leonhardt, who possesses the power of a legendary lion, is a widely admired man but has his own quirks, such as pursuing Cordelia because he was drawn to her scent. How cat-like is this man?! What makes a 'proper adult'? Inspired by the words of his late father, Yutaro Urashima sought to become an upstanding member of society by developing and strictly adhering to his own "Articles of Adulthood." Little did he know, however, that those same articles would go on to dramatically change the world... A new series from the author of Hidarikiki no Eren! Witness the dramatic battle for survival in a surveillance society where reputation is everything!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189692.description:
The manga centers on Sugawara, an employee of a consultant firm, who is not exactly excited about the lectures he give to companies, and finds himself unresponsive in his work. After one night of heavy drinking, he gets kidnapped by an evil organization called the "Black Shock Gang," and he is given the mission to defeat heroes through an "organizational reform."

(Source: Anime News Network)

189694.description:
Lovebirds Ren and Shino have left their school days behind and set out into the world of working adults. Independence is exciting, but living on their own and starting their careers come with a whirlwind of challenges. Ren is struggling to make time in her busy modeling schedule for her girlfriend. Shino is happy about Ren’s success, but she can’t help but notice all the admiring gazes Ren attracts. Then when they’re finally alone, Shino shies from physical intimacy! And to top it all off, Shino gets along with her coworkers and students so well that it’s stoking Ren’s jealousy. Do these high school sweethearts have what it takes to clear these hurdles and build a future together?

(Source: Yen Press)

189697.description:
Our heroine tries her utmost not to end up with one of many bad endings in her newly reincarnated life.

Her life in her original world ended in pain. When she opened her eyes in the next, she realized she'd been reincarnated into a game with an over 98% likelihood of death...

Our heroine has become the daughter of the boss of a heinous mafia group, and in this world, one wrong step would be sure to see her tortured and killed. She now spends her days aiming for one of the two routes where she'd stay alive.

The biggest hurdle now was the boy her father had picked up. She knew that he was responsible for most of the death routes in this game, and also that he would become a spy that betrayed her, and so she worked tirelessly to improve their relationship.

She thought her efforts were paying off, but those peaceful days were shattered by a single betrayal.

"There's no place left for you in this world."

Our heroine discovers the madness that lurks beneath this man who she was sure would kill her as she is dragged down into his deep obsession by way of torturous pleasure.

A New Life As A Dark Elf!

Haruka Yamagishi, a 43-year-old, lonely salaryman without friends, family, or love. Never very good at expressing himself, he’s avoided building relationships with people and finds himself a withered old man before his time. Then one day, he wakes up in another world, only to discover he’s a dark elf, and a beautiful woman at that! Despite having a body as tough as steel and a vast reserve of magical power, the timid Haruka still goes through life indecisively. Yet she (he) forms a party with fellow adventurers twice her (his) age and steadily adapts to this new world. The middle-aged man who once gave up on bonding with others opens his heart and strives to grow as his new self in another world. So the curtain rises on a twisted but classic story of adventure!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

A tale of tender ache and unspoken longing—an otherworldly BL romance, slow-burning and bittersweet.

As such, she’s shunned and ostracized at social gatherings-- until she meets the most sought-after man of the era, Count Vyce. However, this man turns out to be Chris, the poor boy she looked after before abandoning him long ago. The once-fragile boy now approaches her without hesitation. Does he approach out of past attraction, or is there something more underneath?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

189704.description:
The light that fell from the heavens shared a gift with its creations, seeking connection. But humans and their dark hearts would corrupt the very essence of the gift, turning their desires and themselves into twisted, misshapen monstrosities. Yet, there was hope. Heroes would arise--heroes, who would not only stare into the abyss but fight the horrors in it. The gift was golden, but darkness festered within. Now, murky whispers tug on the edge of our consciousness, daring us to make the pact... But with who?

One day on his way to work, Lucas Qin is caught in a subway attack by an aberrant lifeform and takes a fatal blow. When he regains consciousness, every part of his body feels wrong, and his reflection in the train window reveals a terrifying truth: he is still alive, but no longer himself. He has become an aberrant lifeform himself. Teetering between humanity and monstrosity, Lucas must learn to coexist with a parasitic spirit within him while surviving a society that fears what he has become.

Out of the blue, Jiang Yu transmigrates into a xiuxian novel. But who decided that she only deserves to be a small fry who barely even counts as cannon fodder in the novel? And why is she suddenly bound to a useless retribution system? She's not only the bottom-of-the-barrel weakest of the weak, but she's also a tiny black sheep who gets made an example of in the first few chapters of the book!

Born the cherished daughter of a noble family, Won’s life shatters when a sudden tragedy leaves her on the brink of being sold off as a courtesan. One day, I suddenly became the protagonist of a game. However, the more you look at this protagonist... the more you'll sigh. He's got the worst stats, the worst talent and zero connections. Reckless, sharp-tongued, and notoriously troublesome, Sonny challenges everything Benjamin believed about him. As Benjamin gets swept into Sonny’s messy life, he learns that reading between the lines of their shared past holds the key to an unexpected future.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Hyeong, na Keojyeosseo! Yeokkijap BL Danpyeonseon (형, 나 커졌어! 역키잡 BL 단편선) Collection.

189795.description:
Moon Ah-Rim has a secret. One accidental touch, and he can hear exactly what you're thinking. So when he accidentally brushes against his longtime crush, Tae-Hun, he expects butterflies…not full-blown NSFW fantasies! Sweet, gentle Tae-Hun isn’t supposed to have those kinds of thoughts, and especially not about him! Ah-Rim is horrified...and maybe just a little intrigued. Because no matter how much he tells himself not to feel anything...his body’s saying otherwise.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: 勝手に読まないでください！

189798.description:
A man is found murdered in an apartment at 19 Sunset Street. The prime suspect is Leon Devonport, the victim's lover, and all evidence found on the scene of the death seem to point to him. In order to prove his innocence, Leon seeks out Benjamin Wolf, a once-famous detective who has now retired from murder cases due to an incident in his past. Benjamin had long stepped away from murder cases, but at Leon's desperate request, with a bit of flirting, he reluctantly takes the case and begins to investigate. As the investigation progresses, Benjamin uncovers hidden truths behind the case and the complex relationships between all parties involved. What is the truth hidden behind this "murder?" What is Leon hiding from Benjamin?

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Pasión mortal en la calle Sunset 19

title.english: A Murderous Affair at 19 Sunset Street

189799.description:
Lee In-Woo will do anything for his family - no matter the consequences. After learning about a potential plot to leak sensitive information, In-Woo travels back to Korea to track his brother’s last known location. His search leads him to Dr. Kang Do-Woon, a doctor with connections In-Woo is dying to get his hands on. But, as the two grow closer, both of them fall deeper and deeper into a tangled web of deceit and mystery that neither of them could have anticipated... Chasing this rainbow is bound to lead to something much less pleasant than a pot of gold.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189808.description:
Betrayed by her team and abandoned to die in a dungeon, timid C-rank hunter Cho-i Hyeon discovers a cursed ring that keeps her alive by endlessly regenerating her body. Time stretches into years as she’s killed over and over, unable to escape. When she finally does, she’s no longer the girl who was left behind. Stronger, colder, and haunted by something growing inside her, she wants answers -- and revenge. But the ring may have a will of its own, and its true cost is only beginning to surface. Whatever it is, it may already be too late to stop.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!

189809.description: One shot published in WSJ Issue 2023-06/07 once the series had been moved to Jump+ to commemorate the anime airing

title.native: あやかしトライアングル 祭里の誕生日

189810.description:
Chiaki, an aspiring fashion designer, and Ai, a charismatic male model, met in a design class and started dating not long after. Chiaki has always admired Ai, so for him, it’s a dream come true. But the excitement of their new romance is about to get a wake-up call. While working on clothes for a school festival, Chiaki notices Ai spending more and more alone time with their classmate Rin. Is their love truly timeless, or is Chiaki going to be discarded like a piece of fast fashion?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

189811.description:
The last guy you’d expect. The one suit that changes everything. Kim Jiwon grew up in the shadows with no parents, no guidance, and no future. To him, a hoodie is more than just clothing—it is armor against a world that never once gave him a chance. But when he’s pulled into a dangerous incident, something hidden inside him awakens. Now, recruited into Baekya, a covert spy organization that works in the shadows, Jiwon faces a world of secrets, suits, and silent wars. This isn’t just survival. It’s a battle to find the life—and the look—that finally fits.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: สุภาพบุรุษสูทดำ

189812.description:
On his way to school, high school boy Koma Taisuke is approached by a stranger who says to him, "We finally meet again." Koma is surprised, but later that day during class he is introduced to a new transfer student, Chiaki Kei—the same stranger who approached him on the street. What's more, Chiaki claims to be Koma's childhood friend!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

Notes:
- All chapters were split into two parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume release. Bangai-hen 3 (番外編③) published on Pixiv Comic was not included in the volume.
- Includes three extra chapters.

title.native: ちあきくん見守り倶楽部

189813.description:
Helena Winston, the dazzling diva of noble society, is thrust into scandal when the crown prince unexpectedly confesses his love. To protect the Empire—and her own reputation—the Empress proposes a secret deal: marry a man of her choosing and expose his secrets. Her target? Count Benjamin Ischpern, a veiled noble rumored to be tied to enemies of the throne. As Helena begins her life in an arranged marriage, one thing becomes clear—there is indeed far more to this man than it seems. So she swears: she will bring her husband to ruin, no matter the cost.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.
synonyms: How to Send My Husband to the Abyss

title.english: How to Send Your Husband to Hell

189814.description:
A woman's scent that bewitches men...

Published in Young King 2018/11, 2018/12 and 2018/14 issues.

189816.description:
The dragon of the four seasons, summoned to bring balance to the world—among them, the winter guardian dragon, Seherbian Winterbell. Weary of a world that only prays for wishes of fear and curses due to winter’s nature, he falls into a deep ennui. But when Rowan, the dragon priest who had watched over him for so long, dies, Winterbell decides to honor his final wish and journey through the world…

"I wish for you to know more of this world, my dragon… Winterbell."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

189817.description:
A commuter's ride into work turns spicy when a saucy schoolgirl meets his eye and lifts her skirt...

(Source: Irodori Comics)

189818.description: Jian Ye, a damsel in distress, sought to pay her debts. Through her natural ability to see food spirits, she became a painting master and a gourmet influencer. She cures Ou Jinnian, the influential figure of the IT industry, from his feminophobia and anorexia. He lodged himself straight in her house, making her cook for him, paint for him and started to tease her. Yet, she does not remember a past where she saved his life, and how Ou had fallen in love with her many years ago...

189819.description:
The Olympic Village is full of athletes chasing glory, but Korean volleyball star Han Tae-Oh finds himself chasing something else entirely. After a charged encounter with Liam, a charismatic rugby player from the British national team, Tae-Oh cannot hide his attraction. His bold flirting quickly pulls them together, and the tension between them leads to a night neither of them expected. Tae-Oh believes it will remain a secret Olympic fling. Unfortunately, their story does not end there.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.

title.english: Love is a Sport: Unintentional Lift

189820.description:
I witnessed the young master's secret while on an undercover investigation at the mansion!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

189821.description:
Born in Harlem, an inferior omega, and a tattoo artist—Mikey's life was a hardcore noir. To survive in the backstreets, sometimes, one had to risk more than just their life.
While working as a loader on a film set, Mikey was caught badmouthing the famous actor Ryu.

"I can’t believe I’m being discriminated against by a trash-life Yankee. F*cking great."

It was embarrassing, but he figured they’d never meet again.

"Hello, Miki."

Out of nowhere, Ryu appears and asks for a tattoo. And he doesn’t seem to have any intention of leaving. With Ryu visiting his home almost daily, Mikey’s life turns into a complete mess.
"What, are we dating or something?"
"Dating? With you, Miki?"
Does he even realize who he is? A world-famous sex symbol, ridiculously handsome, and a wealthy dominant alpha. No matter how he looked at it, there was no reason for a man like Ryu to get involved with a low-life Yankee like him. So he tried to push him away. "I won’t rush you to remember. But you must remember." Just what happened in the past to make him act like this? As the mystery deepens, fragments of long-forgotten memories begin to resurface…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

189822.description:
Seo Ha-Jun, an alpha, is always the center of attention and the subject of endless rumors in his department. The morning after getting completely drunk, he wakes up to a shocking pain in his lower body and the scent of an Omega. And the person responsible? None other than Oh Yun-U, an Omega surrounded by all kinds of unsettling rumors?! Refusing to accept that he was taken advantage of—especially by that Oh Yun-U— Ha-Jun decides to confront him... "Don't tell me you forgot about last night? Especially after leaving such a clear mark."
(Source: Lezhin, translated)

189823.description: Shimada is a ruthless criminal responsible for indiscriminate mass murder, who later resorts to cannibalism. Nagumo, a police officer, is assigned to escort him, heightening the tension. But what unfolds inside the escort vehicle, packed with criminals, marks the beginning of an unimaginable terror—a new kind of immersive survival horror.

189824.description:
On the day of the high school graduation party, Woobin receives a confession from Hyunho, a male student at the same school. Woobin finds it absurd that the first confession he received as soon as he turned 20 was from a guy, but he feels sorry for Hyunho who is weeping... so he ends up dating him...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

189825.description:
Yeon Hae-Geum, the nation’s one and only S-Class Guide, has been in love for years with Seo Moon-Hyeon - his guardian, mentor, and the man who raised him like family. From teaching him how to eat and read to mastering his guiding abilities, Moon-Hyeon has always been Hae-Geum’s everything. But just when Hae-Geum thinks he'll stay by his side forever, Moon-Hyeon suddenly announces his engagement… without even telling him. Crushed, Hae-Geum prepares to walk away... that is until fate throws in a twist: Seo Moon-Hyeok, Moon-Hyeon’s identical twin brother, shows up. Cold, blunt, and endlessly flirtatious, Moon-Hyeok needs Hae-Geum—not for love, but to power his climb to the top. Still, he’s not above using his twin’s face to seduce him. Now trapped between a possessive first love and a reckless new temptation, Hae-Geum must navigate a storm of emotions, pheromones, and dangerous attraction.

Will he remain loyal to the past—or give in to the thrill of something forbidden? One face, two destinies. One guide, caught in between.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

189827.description:
Annis's ship is attacked by the 'Triba', a race thought to be extinct. As the captain, Annis gives the order to retreat and faces Triba alone. Anis, who was thought to be dead, is bound by Triba's tentacles, and his blocked 'libido' is turned back on and he ends up being toyed with by Triba...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

189828.description:
Chiwa is a country ruled by eight families that originate from mythology. The members of the eight families have special powers called "jutsu", and a man with particularly strong jutsu will ascend to the throne of Chiwa.

Long ago, one of the eight families, the Amaha family, left the capital, causing chaos, but this subsided when a girl from Amaha is chosen to be the hostage queen.

This time, Amaha Awayuki was chosen to be the wife of the new king, Ichimine Naruya. She cannot even touch the king, and can only see him once a month - such a restrictive political marriage has no love or affection. Awayuki was trying to kill her heart and carry out her duties as a hostage. However, using her own ability to see things from afar, "Heavenly Eyes and Heavenly Ears", Awayuki secretly observes Naruya, and learns his unknown feelings, and gradually becomes interested in him---?

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

189829.description:
Jin-Ho and Chun-Do are two best friends wasting their summer days away. But when they find a lottery ticket on the street by chance, they're thrown into a mysterious treasure hunt with two strange girls they don't fully understand.

(Source: Tapas)

189830.description:
Several hundred years ago, when the world was devastated by the war between dragons and humans, humans tried to create peace by offering a 'bride' to the dragons every 300 years. After a long, long time, Baek Chan-Woo had to become the bride of this generation. All dragons are beautiful, so he was looking forward to the meeting, but he was blatantly disappointed when a man, Shin Tae-Oh, showed up instead of a woman.

"I have to see him begging to marry me."

However, Tae-Oh seemed to be intrigued by him appearance..!?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes 23 extra chapters.

189831.description:
Mick the Divine Blade, once renowned as the world's strongest monster hunter, now runs a weapon shop in a remote corner of the world. When a young party of hunters came across his store unaware of his identity, they end up venturing into a dungeon with him... What adventures await?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189835.description:
Adventurer 'Benzak' hides in a cave with a map, his grandfather's heirloom, in search of the 'most beautiful treasure'. However, a more dazzling and beautiful being than the treasure,'Rhys', was waiting in the cave.

"You've finally come to keep your promise with me?"

Rhys soon reveals his gigantic figure along with unknown words...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

189841.description:
Do Ha-Neul is an ordinary college student living a bright and carefree life. Her only complex is that she has difficulty making choices due to the trauma of her parents’ divorce. One day, when she was bored and ordinary, she meets a famous art student, Kang Seon-Han, who is famous for being handsome… “Don’t you remember me?” Kang Seon-Han approaches her suspiciously as if they know each other, and while she gets entangled with him, her first love Seo Hae-Yang comes to visit her, and somehow she ends up living with her first love in the same house. Kang Seon-Han, whose future is certain, and Seo Hae-Yang, who unwaveringly follows her own path. The two people are strangely similar. “I like you.” The same confession from the two people who look similar. “Think about it carefully. You like me too, right?” Both of them are sure that Ha-Neul likes them. Who do I really like? I like them both so much. But there is only one choice. You or you. At the moment of choice that comes, they realize true love.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

189842.description:
Serving a young master can be demanding in several ways, as poor Jayed learns while working as Seo Onka's bodyguard. Not only does he have to accompany Seo on all his nights of debauchery, but he's also constantly tempted by his sultry looks and body. Still, Jayed feels conflicted escorting Seo on his trip to meet his prospective fiancee in the desert. He knows this might be his last time seeing Seo alive, and not because the desert's crawling with dangerous criminals. But what he doesn't know is that things are about to heat up in a completely unexpected way...

(Source: Tappytoon)

189849.description:
What are you gripping? ♥

(Source: Fakku)

Note: Published in COMIC X-EROS #122.

めっちゃヤる気だ! 安城さん

189851.description:
The Third Time’s The Charm!

Princess That never received an actual name and suffered many years of abuse. Each time she meets her untimely end, she’s sent back into the past, and during her third loop, she restarts as a three-year-old girl. What’s more, the imperial family’s guardian deity—the Golden Dragon—takes notice of her this time. Even the legendary, ultra fluffy Flame Tiger latches onto her! Despite being That’s older brother, the crown prince never showed any interest in her, yet in this loop, he dubs her an angel. Will her father—the infamously cold-blooded emperor—shower her with affection as well?! The nameless princess will fight with all her strength to survive and earn a name of her own!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)
synonyms: The Nameless Princess and the Ruthless Emperor

title.english: Third Loop: The Nameless Princess and the Cruel Emperor
title.native: ななしの皇女と冷酷皇帝 虐げられた幼女、今世では龍ともふもふに溺愛されています
title.romaji: Nanashi no Oujo to Reikoku Koutei Shiitagerareta Youjo, Konse de wa Ryuu to Mofumofu ni Dekiai Sareteimasu

189852.description:
“It’ll be six months at most.”

Just like that, my ordinary life crumbled with a single sentence—a sudden terminal diagnosis I never saw coming. As if that wasn’t enough, my best friend of over ten years suddenly confesses: “I’ve loved you… for more than a decade.” Now I have half a year left. Just six months. A brief flicker of time where everything feels both too short and painfully long. What am I supposed to do with a love I never had the chance to notice? How do I hold on to a future that’s slipping away before it can begin? In these fleeting days, it’s just you and me—stumbling through borrowed time, trying to find meaning in the moments we still have. If our time together is limited… Can love still be enough?

(Source: Lezhin US)

189853.description:
When the ruthless Lord Tiwakan seizes the kingdom of Nauk, Princess Liene Arsac faces an impossible choice: marry her captor or watch her homeland crumble. But Lord Tiwakan isn’t just after power; he desires Liene, and his devotion stirs a mix of fear and undeniable attraction within her. With her former betrothed, Lafitte, still missing, Liene must decide whether to trust Tiwakan's promises or hold out hope for a rescue. As dangerous secrets come to light, Liene’s decision could change the fate of Nauk—and her own heart—forever.

(Source: WEBTOON)

189854.description:
A pair of lovers who committed suicide fell into the sea. Under the sea was the place where the soul of the 虣 Zhanhong was sealed. Faced with the body that he had obtained without any effort, he decisively took the body of the one closest to him and saved the other one. So after Qingxi was rescued, he found that

(Source: Tencent, translated)

189855.description:
Sheffield lets his emotions take over him when he hears that his stepfather's illegitimate son, Randol, wants to reunite with the family. On a whim, he decides to give his "big brother" a little welcome "gift" - spending a passionate night with him...

(Source: Webcomics)

189856.description:
The goblin Lee Mae, who lived peacefully in the mountains, has his life completely changed by two women. He has never loved or hated anyone this much before! A spirited girl, a mischievous fox, and a cruel but pure goblin. Whether the relationship between the three is good or bad, one thing is certain. It will end only when one of them dies! A lyrical romance drama that alternates between joy and sorrow.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: They Say Goblins Don't Know How To Cry

189857.description:
[Friend's Son Hee-Woo x Uncle Kang-Il]

Kang-Il is scammed by his close older brother and his only billiard hall is in danger of being taken over. At that time, his brother's son Hee-Woo, whom he had been waiting for so long to hear from, appears in front of Kang-Il. Kang-Il tries to hold on to Hee-Woo, but is attacked by Hee-Woo and passes out... When Kang-Il wakes up again, he is being raped by Hee-Woo on the billiard table.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

189858.description:
During his school days, Gio accidentally discovered a rock band called Aurora, which became his muse. Inspired by them, he pursued a career in music and became a skilled composer. However, Aurora couldn’t survive in the overwhelming digital music market and eventually disappeared. Gio could never forget the voice of Aurora’s vocalist—until one day, a mysterious man named Seon-Gyu appeared before him. Their first encounter was suspicious, but through his best friend Hee-Seop, Gio learned an astonishing fact: Seon-Gyu’s voice resembled that of Aurora’s vocalist.

"Hyung, please, just sing once!"

"No."

All he wanted was to hear a single note—why was it so difficult?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

189859.description:
In the heart of Shinjuku, there are a variety of nightclubs open to customers who seek a night of indulgence alongside gorgeous companions. Yamada is one of those companions, working part-time while attending university. Though lately, Yamada finds it easier to become the model hostess rather than a star pupil. She keeps to herself, follows the written and unwritten rules of hosting, and doesn’t bother getting entangled with anyone if she can help it. That is, until Mii-chan stumbles into her life.

Mii-chan is adorable but useless. She can’t read or write and is incredibly clumsy, always messing something up, which earns her ridicule from staff and customers alike. But something about her endless motivation and bright energy draws Yamada in, creating an unexpected friendship!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes:
- Ranked 4th in the Men's Division of Takarajimasha's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! 2026 guidebook.
- Nominated for the 50th Kodansha Manga Award in the General category in 2026.

title.native: みいちゃんと山田さん

189860.description:
Kuro, a black cat, is a god of fortune down on her luck. She’s turned into a “vengeful god” against her will, and the only way to return to her former status is to curse seven generations of the Nishikori bloodline. She’s close to being free, but to get there, she needs to make sure the seventh generation actually gets born. That means finding a match for Nishikori Kotaro…which is harder than you might think, because Kotaro is tragically unpopular. Not only that, he insists that the only woman he wants…is cat-eared Kuro herself!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
189860.hashtag: #７代祟りますので早く結婚してください

title.english: Get Married So I Can Curse Your Firstborn and Finally Be Free!
title.native: 7代祟りますので早く結婚してください!
title.romaji: 7-dai Tatarimasu node Hayaku Kekkon shite Kudasai!

189861.description:
Born into a noble family of master swordsmen, fifteen-year-old Hiraku Mato was destined to inherit the legendary Sword Saint skill at his coming-of-age appraisal ceremony. But when the ceremony reveals his gift to be the seemingly worthless "Unlocker" skill, his future crumbles before his eyes. With no historical record mentioning his skill, people assume it can only do mundane things like open doors and windows. But a chance encounter uncovers its hidden potential: the ability to unlock status windows, hidden skills, and even rare drop items. Armed with this cheat-like power, Hiraku sets out to carve his own path in this action-packed fantasy!

(Source: Manga UP!)

title.native: 俺だけステータスオープンできる件～俺だけステータス確認できる世界でチートスキルもS級アイテムも選び放題～

Chise lost her mother when she was little and lives with her father, a writer. The only man she likes is her father.

(Source: Cocohana, translated)

Mochiko, a third-year high school student, is in love with Mr. Kito, who is known to be a coward despite his tough appearance. She tries every trick in the book to get close to Mr. Kito, but she can't seem to get a response, but what about the man in question...?

The one-shot centers on Tetsuo Tanba and Misaki Kurogane, two members of the "Japan Angel Federation Sendoff Department" who search for souls who cannot pass on to the afterlife due to lingering regrets, and send them to the afterlife.

Miho, who lives in poverty, loses the money her mother finally managed to raise for a school trip. Unwittingly, she steals money from her classmates...

Published in Shoujo Club/Special New Year 1961 issue.

189881.description: Long, long ago, there were two orphan brothers, Ogna and Syra. To make a living, they spend their days tending to the fields and raising silkworms. One day, the younger brother, Syra, starts to be concerned about beauty and what it means to be beautiful, much to his older brother's chagrin. A rift begins to form between the two brothers when Syra encounters someone in a lake, someone who loves him for his beauty...

189882.description: The story of a struggling up-and-coming mangaka, tormented by the cry of the laughing kookabura.
synonyms: Keep This a Secret From the Laughing Kookaburra

title.native: 笑いかわせみにいえない話

189883.description:
Modern Japan—Anarchy City, a metropolis rampant with crime.

Mimi Usazaki, a depressed college student attending therapy while trudging through her university life, one day gets caught up in a bizarre experiment. As a result, she ends up sharing her mind with her long-lost younger brother, Hyou Usazaki—a death row inmate. Now, she’s dragged into a deadly battle against other death row prisoners who were also part of the experiment…!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: マンティコア-精神移行実験街-

189884.description:
Impatient 29-year-old omega Shishikura has watched all his friends get married while his own romances keep fizzling out. Sparks fly when he starts up an enemies-with-benefits relationship with his alpha coworker Kotani. Despite the clash of their difficult personalities, their romance is undeniable, and the two begin dating. But when Shishikura brings up his desire to get married, Kotani refuses! Shishikura will have to get to the bottom of Kotani’s deep-seated issues about omegas before there can be any happily ever after.

(Source: SuBLime)

Note: Includes "Unmei no Tsugai to Onsen Ryokou da Nante" (運命の番と温泉旅行だなんて, Worst Hot Springs Trip Ever) and an extra chapter.

189888.description:
I became the first son of the Demonic Heaven clan—one of the Six Great Clans of the Heavenly Demonic Cult—Jin Yeomyung. I was ready to enjoy a sweet life with a silver spoon in my mouth, but thanks to that damn Murim Alliance, the Heavenly Demonic Cult was destroyed. But in my final moments, Cult Leader Cheon Yura turned to me and said...

“Would you mind seducing me?”

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: My Wife is the Demonic Cult Leader
My Wife Is The Leader Of A Demonic Cult

189889.description:
Ga-Ram, a reclusive and introverted otaku, starts the beautiful girl dating simulation "Knock, Knock, Knock Real Love" on the recommendation of his friend Seo-Ah. Among countless beautiful girls, the person who captured Ga-Ram's heart is none other than the charming and dependable father of "Kwon Ye-Na," "Kwon Tae-Oh"! Ga-Ram was approaching "Ye-Na" to get "Teo-Oh" but he chose the wrong option... Due to a system error, he became the main character of "Knock, Knock, Knock Real Love?!"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
synonyms: I'm Sorry, but Daddy Is My Type!

189890.description:
Do Woo-Jin, a bassist in an indie band, was an oddball with a strangely gloomy aura—and an almost absurd amount of bad luck. After his previous bands disbanded one after another, leaving him with nowhere to go, a third chance finally came his way. It was in this new band that he met Choi Hui-Su…

For Hui-Su, who had lived an ordinary life—his biggest act of rebellion being the pentagram tattoo on his forearm—Woo-Jin, whose thoughts were impossible to read, felt nothing but awkward. During a post-practice drinking session, while the band members chatted boisterously, Woo-Jin answered half-heartedly with an uncomfortable expression—until his gaze landed on Hui-Su’s tattoo.

“…A pentagram symbolizes the devil.”

For the first time, a spark of interest flickered in Woo-Jin’s otherwise empty eyes. But wait, what had their bandmate said while introducing Woo-Jin earlier?

"I warned you, didn’t I? That guy’s a total nutcase."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

189894.description: Note: Published in Web Haishin Gekkan Tonari no Kininaru Oku-san Vol. 035

title.native: 夜のキンダーガーデン
ウマノリ！ガールズパーティー

189896.description:
The grim city of Oosaka is controlled by the Yakuza. On the secluded artificial island of Sakishima, there exists a rumour: There is a "wolf" out hunting the Yakuza. This wolf would use a demon sword to slay the Yakuza's dignity. That is, this sword has the ability to turn them into little girls!!!!

A tale of the high-school student who hunts Yakuza and the former-Yakuza girl! These pretend-siblings with a bond too strong will face the Yakuza infesting Oosaka. This is a battle-filled and action-packed story of chivalry featuring big twists and turns!!!

title.native: タマとられちゃったよおおおぉ

189897.description: Note: Published in COMIC AOHA 2020 Haru

title.native: ウワサの先が、知りたくて

189898.description:
Over summer break, Mori has decided to change his look along with Yamori, the guy who sits behind him in class. Their seasonal debut is a success…but why is Yamori now in girl's clothing? And suddenly he's acting strangely and making suggestive comments…?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: まどわせないで矢守くん

189899.description:
The manga's story is about a new police division known as the "7th Division," which handles supernatural cases where criminals get possessed by evil spirits. A group of young police officers with special powers work together to solve these supernatural cases.

(Source: Anime News Network)

189900.description:
Seong Serim grew into womanhood without having ever felt love from a man. No matter how she used her body or her words, it never seemed to be enough. So when she meets Cha Juhyeok, who cares for her despite his cold demeanor, she is instantly smitten. Fast forward years later, and she is the successful CEO of her own entertainment company. One of her actors, Ha Yeonwu, will do anything to please his boss…anything. With two men vying for her attention, their touches both intoxicating, how is Serim supposed to choose? Well, maybe she doesn’t have to…

(Source: Lezhin US)

189901.description: Published in Shoujo Club/Special New Year 1961 issue.

title.native: ママはやっぱりはなしがわかる
title.romaji: Mama wa Yappari Hanashi ga Wakaru

189902.description:
Hyejun, a feisty female bodyguard, is hired by the young Jaehyun, but when she walks into his house, it’s full of… more guards. But instead of protecting him, they're keeping him there. To hide her true identity as his personal guard, she goes undercover by pretending to be his girlfriend. One day, their undeniable attraction pulls them together to share a kiss. Now, as the lie seeps into their reality, having a strictly professional relationship is becoming less of an option.

(Source: Tapas)

189903.description: Published in Shoujo Club/Special New Year 1961 issue.

189904.description: Published in Shoujo Club/Special New Year 1961 issue.

189905.description:
Ju-Yeong Nam, the boss of a multinational corporation, has been doing his best to defy the fate of a super-rich male lead, only to be swept off his feet by a princess falling from the sky! Will he succeed in returning this princess, with her strange hair color and even stranger personality, to her world safely?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

189906.description:
“Your IQ is high. But can your EQ get any lower?”

Chronically single Bai DuoDuo sneaks a picture in a seminar. Little does she know, that picture gets her into a whole world of trouble. Now, she’s being forced to marry a tall, handsome, and well-off scientist. However, the more she looks at him the more she dislikes him.

(Source: Comikey)

189908.description:
Tae-Yang thought he'd never see Ji-Wan again after their messy breakup, but fate and the media have other plans. Now a heroic firefighter with a documentary deal, Tae-Yang reunites with his producer ex at the broadcasting station... except Ji-Wan is doing everything he can to avoid him. But then, why does he have a seven-year-old kid with the same name as Tae-Yang? Once he secures seven dates with Ji-Wan as "payment" for using his name, it's up to Tae-Yang to do some detective work and win over his reluctant ex in seven Sundays.

(Source: Tappytoon)

189909.description:
Earth, many years after humanity has disappeared. At the Gingarou Hotel in Ginza, Tokyo, hotelier robot Yachiyo and her robot colleagues patiently await their owner’s return, and for the day when they might once again welcome human guests. However, the first guest to arrive in 100 years is an extraterrestrial.

One after another, guests begin to arrive, but are they here to stay, to invade, or perhaps...? The hospitality of Yachiyo and the team, with the pride of the Gingarou Hotel on the line, is about begin!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title.native: アポカリプスホテルぷすぷす

title.romaji: Kare wa Watashi no Sefure no Toriko

189911.description:
I reincarnate into a villainess, Elenia, who eventually dies out of deep jealousy for the saint. If that weren't bad enough, I reincarnate into her body the day after she seduces the saint's most loyal paladin, Laurent, to spend a night with her. I insist that nothing has happened between us, but Laurent urges me to take responsibility for taking his virginity. Later, he negotiates with the emperor and asks for me. I, Elenia Arpine, am the sole thing he wants.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
