Who wouldn’t be excited to find themselves transmigrated into a TV show? You get to meet your favorite characters, maybe even have a wayward romance...but for Si-On Baek, it turns out to be more horror than romcom. It's just his luck to end up as the secretary to one of the most ruthless and powerful alphas on TV. Now he has to figure out how to survive while hiding his omega status, which is proving to be quite difficult when alpha Tae-Oh Yoon won’t stop getting so damn close…

(Source: Tapas)

189918.description:
Ga-Hyeon never expected to find himself inside a novel, let alone as the Constellation of the villain, Tae-Beom Baek. Determined to prevent the world’s destruction, he decides to sponsor Tae-Beom and lead him down a righteous path instead, but there’s one problem—he’s broke. As Ga-Hyeon struggles to alter Tae-Beom’s fate, their bond deepens, and Ga-Hyeon faces a hard truth: his efforts to save the world may push Tae-Beom toward the very destruction he’s trying to stop.

(Source: Tapas)

189919.description:
Isca is a promiscuous dark wizard who scrapes by doing guild quests. In a dungeon, he meets Sian, a beautiful priest hiding his looks, and Khalit, a demon prince seeking his lost powers.

Sparks fly, jealousy brews, and an accidental quest to save their world begins!

(Source: Manta)

Je mehr, desto besser, oder nicht?

189922.description:
Count Scrooge Caroldt was once an imperial tutor who betrayed Crown Prince Calsion and was executed, and I woke up in his body! I decided to change my fate by properly guiding the prince and years later, on the night of his coming-of-age ball, I was finally going to retire and live happily ever after. That is, until Calsion ripped up my resignation letter and forced his desires on me...! Now he wants to make me his consort?! I just wanted to retire in peace!

(Source: Lezhin US)

189924.description: A retired samurai encounters what seems to be a humble seahorse left to die on the sands of a local beach, when it reaches out in a feeble voice to him to save him.

189925.description:
A world where two worlds exist: Grimoire, where wizards live, and Grand Earth, where humans live. Theo, a boy who is human who has a special constitution, visits the magical city of Grimoire to learn about himself. There, he meets the great wizard Lucas, who Theo decides to talk to, but his physical condition causes a terrible situation. Furthermore, he learns Lucas's shocking secret――!?

A story of the bond woven between a lonely wizard with a secret and a boy with a special constitution.

(Source: Zero-Sum Online, translated)

title.native: NHK その時歴史が動いた 昭和史激動編
title.romaji: NHK Sono Toki Rekishi ga Ugoita: Shouwa-shi Gekidou-hen

189927.description:
Half a century ago, the Cosmic Demon Delekacon was sealed away, averting Earth's destruction! And now, Pec - the demon's left eye known as Eye Boy - is living it up as a permanent freeloader with his best friend Keigo?! A groundbreaking 79-page one-shot mixing youth, sci-fi, and friendship!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

189928.description:
This tale begins before my time. In the Zeode Fortress of the Free State, locked in war with the Empire, there dwelt a beast that preyed upon all who dared invade…

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: The Beast of the Chocolate Lily
title.native: チョコレートリリィの怪物

189929.description: Note: Published in Weekly Shounen Jump 2025 issue 19.

title.romaji: Chikuwaga Okakoto Gakko Joreibu Tanjou Hiwa

189930.description:
My husband is hot on my trail!

Eloise, a fugitive with a dark past, and Lord Johannes, the temple’s relentless hound, enter a marriage built on lies. With one year to live, Eloise must steal the Stone of Time from Johannes without revealing her identity. Can she survive this deadly game of deception?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: I Am Being Chased by My Husband

189931.description: I was reborn into the world of my favorite otome game! But my favorite character seems to be acting strange...

title.native: ハッピーエンドはおあずけです!

189933.description:
Kim Jeong-Hyun, who works as a reporter at a broadcasting station, is instructed by the deputy editor to attend a charity party held at an old house. The atmosphere of the informal gathering, attended by various wealthy individuals, is not very good, and feeling tired, Kim Jeong-Hyun decides to take a nap a little earlier. That night, in his dream, Jeong-Hyun dreams of being assaulted by a mysterious man.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 side story chapters.
synonyms: [Seongbidan Inoetammi] The Sound of Sheep Breathing

189935.description: Reiichi Hoshino, a gay salesman, can't help but be interested in Haruki Madoka, a man in the systems management department who is seen in the company as a weirdo. One day, he impulsively confesses his feelings to him and they start dating, but he's not good at socializing and has zero dating experience. Hoshino even mistakes his excitement for Madoka for a cold. Still, he is irresistibly drawn to Madoka, who is manly despite his clumsiness and more devoted than anyone else---

title.native: 恋の管理はできません！

189936.description:
Drowned in overwhelming guilt and despair, Father Vence Reich decides to end it all in the quiet solitude of his village monastery. But just as his fingers brace on the trigger of his rifle, a blinding white light bursts through the gloom. Suspended from the attic ceiling is a terrifying yet mesmerizing entity—and Vence instantly falls to his knees, convinced he is looking at God. As he surrenders both his body and soul to this "God" of snake-like tongues and luminous tentacles, Vence spirals into a deep, consuming dependency. In the name of devotion, the unholy communion begins...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title.native: 愛が重たいインキュバス

189938.description:
Kotaruo, a shy new host, is not good at serving people and is always at the bottom of the list. The stray cat Yamato is his only source of comfort. Then one day when he wakes up he finds Yamato in human form, naked and in the same bed, and he asks to be his lover and mate!?

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

title.native: ネコはホストに抱かれたい

189939.description:
Tsukinashi Hikari lives her life positively, believing she is lucky even though others may see her as unlucky, and Suehiro Koichi is a man who is naturally lucky. The story begins when the two, who were job-hunting students, meet at a company interview venue.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

189940.description:
The series is about the old man Breed, who is fired from his job and exiled from his country. His dragons follow him, however, and so begins his journey to reclaim his glory.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 国を追われた竜師さん、拾われた隣国でうっかり無双してしまう。 ～弱小国家が大陸最強の竜の楽園になるまで～
title.romaji: Kuni wo Owareta Ryuushi-san, Hirowareta Ringoku de Ukkari Musou Shiteshimau.: Jakushou Kokka ga Tairiku Saikyou no Ryuu no Rakuen ni Naru made

189941.description:
Thirty years ago, Lynn embarked on a quest to destroy the Orb of Evil, but she was betrayed and sacrificed by her companions to seal the orb. Now, she has woken up in the body of a young girl, only to find out that she was framed as a traitor and is now remembered as such in history. To make matters worse, the child whose body she's borrowing appears to have been traumatized by years of abuse. Lynn is determined to set the record straight... But first, she'll avenge this little girl!

(Source: Tapas)

189942.description:
#System##Goddess# A down-and-out guy, who's been treated unfairly, gets the invincible Title System and turns his life around. From then on, he scores all the big wins and lives the high life, surrounded by all sorts of hotties.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: I Defeat Countless Tycoons with my Title System
title.native: 我靠称号系统打败万千神豪
title.romaji: Wokao Chenghao Xitong Dabai Wanqian Shen Hao

189943.description:
After years of toil and ridicule, one man finally found the Artifacts—remnants of a lost technology so advanced that they cannot be replicated. Several years later, that same man founded a criminal organization in Korea—the Daejung Syndicate. The man expanded his influence using five child soldiers he armed with Artifacts, and Gil-Ja is one of them. But Gil-Ja soon realizes that the Artifacts can free her of the syndicate entirely. However, this freedom comes with a steep price...

(Source: Tapas)

189944.description:
Gyeo-Ul has lucked into a marriage with a rich, handsome, and kind man. The catch? She has no idea how it happened. After an accident wipes out the past year of her memory, Gyeo-Ul finds herself living a life she doesn't recognize: Si-Hu Kang, her sworn enemy, is now her doting spouse, and he won't stop gushing over her.

“Wait, I have to share a bed with this guy? And kiss him, too?! Why does he keep saying he loves me?!”

Something about this marriage doesn’t add up.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: One Day I Found a Husband
記憶を失ったら大嫌いな人と結婚してました
สามีที่ไม่ได้ขอ

title.native: 親子で...小〇生で妊娠して赤ちゃん産んじゃいました
title.romaji: Oyako de Shou〇sei de Ninshin Shite Aka-chan Unja Imashita

189947.description:
Police officer Tadamasa, as part of the non-human countermeasures squad, is watched over by the incubus Ink, who falls in love with him. The two once had a relationship but Tadamasa says that "sex does not equal love." Ink decides to work hard to make Tadamasa "like him properly," not just physically. An incubus who is forceful when it comes to sex but clumsy when it comes to love struggles! An erotic and sweet romcom between a dog-like incubus and a strict police officer!

Source: Renta!, translated

title.native: 恋に堕ちたインキュバス

189948.description:
The main character, Koga, was portraying Natsuki Shimai, an overwhelmingly beautiful woman who is constantly rumored. As if to express something that cannot be put into words. "Don't you think I'm more beautiful?" When she said that and turned around, Natsuki Shimai herself was there...!?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

189949.description:
"Charm" makes men drunk with love and manipulates them, but in return, it is a terrifying power that shortens one's own lifespan. Azusa, who was born into a family that inherits the blood of "charm", but is talentless, decides to eliminate the blood of "charm" from this world in order to save her younger sister who has a strong power. She ends up in a political marriage with Yukiya, who also bears a grudge against "charm". The relationship between the two families is terrible, but...

A Japanese-style fantasy romantic comedy begins with a talentless but unyielding bride and a pitiful but strong handsome husband!

(Source: Bessatsu Friend, translated)

title.native: 帝都のジュリエット 〜無才の花嫁が幸せになるまで〜
title.romaji: Teito no Juliet: Musai no Hanayome ga Shiawase ni Naru Made

189950.description:
"Living as a gal is seriously the best!!"

Mimiru was an introvert in middle school, but when she entered high school, she made her long-awaited debut as a gal, thinking, "Maybe I can become a gal too!?" She made friends with three girls: Yuuhi, a cool beauty with a calm and pretty look; Fuuka, a cute gal with a soft and fluffy look; and Kurumi, a cheerful and energetic gal who is good at sports. Now she has joined the gal group she has always admired! While she lives the sparkling life she has always dreamed of, she also pushes herself too hard to keep up with her friends. And she also notices new feelings growing within her...

title.native: ギャル推しJKはギャルになりたい
title.romaji: Gal Oshi JK wa Gal ni Naritai

189951.description: Ginji, who lives in the countryside and is looking forward to moving to Tokyo in the spring, has a special ability: he can see monsters. Ginji, who stands between humans and monsters, and the unique monsters weave together in a graffiti story of monsters moving to Tokyo!

189952.description:
High school student Izumi is invited by a friend to go to a live music venue for the first time! However, when she nervously hands over her ticket to enter, she is told, "Junior high school students are not allowed." She soon bumps into a rude man, and during the concert she can't get into the music at all... Feeling down, the rude man calls out to her, saying, "Let me apologize"...!?

Love resonates loudly inside the venue, and the heart rate soars in this love story between a live music venue manager and a grown-up high school girl!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: ふゆりぃな先生のろーばい

放課後異世界ふたり旅 ～いらない勇者ひきとります～

189962.description:
In a universe overrun by the dark primordial beasts known as Krakens, the remnants of humanity contend for black ether, a fearsome energy source harvested from black holes. Amid the wreckages of war, the heroic spy Oriale takes on a critical mission!

(Source: K Manga)

189963.description:
Kotaro is a college student who is troubled by his tendency to get extremely nervous around girls. That's when he was introduced to the handsome and super popular upperclassmen, Azuma Takatoh. Contrary to Kotaro's expectations, Azuma was a friendly guy, and after consulting him about his worries, Azuma agrees to help him, but... Kotaro can't stop his heart from pounding in front of Azuma's overwhelming handsomeness...!! On top of that, Azuma tells Kotaro to practice with him, and forces his burning hot tongue into Kotaro's mouth! That was Kotaro's first french kiss, and it made his body melt and his dick hard...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: บทเรียนรักจากรุ่นพี่สุดฮอต
就由我來開發你吧～超受歡迎的學長的下流課程

title.english: I'll Help You Develop -Erotic Lessons With an Extremely Popular Senior-
title.native: 俺が開発してあげる～爆モテ先輩のやらしいレッスン
title.romaji: Ore ga Kaihatsu Shite Ageru: Baku Mote Senpai no Yarashii Lesson

189965.description:
At night in the office, I'm on my knees with a collar around my neck. The one who holds my leash is Miyazawa... he's my senior colleague at work but sometimes he has this naughty smile across his face... how did things end up like this?! Miyazawa is perfect. Perfect form, mind-melting charms, and incredible reliability have any woman falling head over heels for him. On top of all of that though, he's so kind... someone I've come to admire... One day, he tasked me with picking up a package, saying not to open it no matter what. I don't know what happened... but I opened the package... and now I only obey his every command. "Now you're going to try all of this with me." Our relationship changed in an instant... what exactly does this mean for us...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

189967.description:
On New Year’s Eve, a pink smoke bomb turns the city into chaos, infecting people with a virus that transforms them into animal hybrids driven by uncontrollable lust. Yeonwoo and her friend Dojin hide out at Dojin's house after she infects him, but hunger forces them outside... into a world gone wild. With no cure in sight and a mysterious woman watching it all unfold, the only rule left is: stay inside… or lose yourself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

189968.description:
Late at night, an unknown woman suddenly appears at In-Hyeok's doorstep. She claims she's the inheritance sent by his father. Obeying every command without question, her presence awakens the dark desires Dominic has been suppressing deep inside...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

189969.description: Note: Published in COMIC MILK PUDDING 2011-09

189970.description:
Lee Hyun and Yoon Jae, who met by chance at a gay bar, are teammates and sex partners in the same swimming team. Enjoying their time together without worrying about the location, Lee Hyun and Yoon Jae accidentally expose their intimate scene to Seo Hoo, a swimming pool staff member...

(Source: Mr Blue, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

title.native: ニジュウジンカクショウジョ
俺の姉貴はエロ漫画家
title.romaji: Ore no Aneki wa Ero Mangaka

189973.description: Note: Published in COMIC MILK PUDDING 2011-07

189974.description:
Gods collide, nations clash, and chaos reigns. Who will bring order to chaos and save the world? Will ambitions be quelled by a sinful past? Are sacrifices inevitable or is there a better way?

(Source: Tapas)

189975.description:
The sci-fi comedy manga centers on Sanpo, a junior high school girl who loves inventions and who meets a space creature named Nuno. Sanpo gets involved with Nuno's search for "space artifacts," super technology from space that are scattered around Earth. These "space artifacts," which are believed to be able to destroy Earth with a single switch, start to cause trouble in Sanpo's daily life. With Sanpo's tech skills and Nuno's knowledge, the two take on these "space artifact" incidents.

(Source: Anime News Network)

189977.description:
1-2. Bakunyuu Bijo-tachi wo Saimin de Otegaru Netori (爆乳美女たちを催眠でお手軽寝取り)
3-4. Yuri-nee to Sono Kanojo wo Netoru! (百合姉とその彼女を寝取る!)
5-6. Hatsuiku no Yoi Sukumizu Joshi-tachi ga Youmuin no Ossan to (発育の良いスク水女子たちが用務員のおっさんと)

自慢の母はあの男に抱かれている

189978.description:
Once cursed to never love, Crown Prince Kalart stuns the royal ball by declaring his love… for a hefty black cat that looks more suited to a back alley than a palace. Determined to win the cat’s affection, he brings its seemingly ordinary owner, Roserikta, into the royal palace. But appearances can be deceiving—Roserikta is clearly hiding something… something magical. Thus begins a whimsical romance between a cursed prince, a mysterious woman, and one unforgettable feline.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: That’s Just How First Love Is, Your Highness

title.english: This is What First Love Is Like, Your Majesty

189980.description:
Miles Shen had it all—good looks, money, the works. Then everything collapsed. His family empire crumbled, he went from trust fund kid to drowning in debt, and his materialistic girlfriend kicked him to the curb without a backward glance. Just when he's hit absolute rock bottom, he gets the "Perfect Life System". The rules? Spend money on any girl who likes him enough (affection level over 60), and he gets double his money back! And just like that, Miles is living a life where normal people go broke from spending, but he just keeps getting richer. He's throwing money around like it's nothing, and somehow his bank account just keeps growing!

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: After Becoming Financially Free, They Offered Their Loyalty
They Offered Their Loyalty to Me After I Obtained Financial Freedom

title.english: Perfect Life System: Double Cash for Her Favor
title.native: 财富自由后，她们献上了忠诚
title.romaji: Caifu Ziyou Hou, Tamen Xianshangle Zhongcheng

189981.description:
Minjun wished for the world to end-- until it did. When a zombie appears at his door, the bullied teen chooses to fight for survival. Teaming up with Yena, his sassy yet charming classmate, he flees the collapsing city. Hunted by the infected and haunted by enemies old and new, they discover that in a world without rules, trust may be their only chance at survival.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ผู้กล้าฝ่าวันสิ้นโลก

189984.description:
In the 15th year of the Tenmon era, Fuuma Kotarou—the fifth in a long line of fierce warriors—fought for survival in a world torn apart by endless warfare and haunted by dark, supernatural forces.

Driven by a single, unyielding resolve—to do whatever it took to stay alive—he cut down countless foes, narrowly escaping death time and again. Yet fate had its own plans: captured and executed, his life seemed to come to a tragic end.

But just when all hope was lost, a mysterious figure known only as “THE SEER OF WORLDS” reached out to him. In that fateful moment, the cycle of reincarnation was unleashed, and Fuuma Kotarou was reborn in a completely new realm—a second chance to reclaim the humanity he once lost.

(Source: LINE Manga, translated)
synonyms: Ninja Reincarnation: Fuuma Kotarou's Quest to Reclaim His Humanity

title.native: 忍法異世界転生 〜風魔小太郎は異世界で人間を取り戻す〜
title.romaji: Ninpou Isekai Tensei: Fuuma Kotarou wa Isekai de Ningen wo Torimodosu

189988.description:
Ye Yao changed her name to Bai Fei and dressed as a man to infiltrate the Ling clan, the most powerful family in A City. Bai Fei became the trusted right-hand man for the Ling family's unruly heir Ling Ye, and he treated her like a brother-in-arms. Until during an undercover mission where Bai Fei was forced to dress up as a woman, and Bai Fei couldn't help herself and kissed Ling Ye after getting drunk.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Fall in Love With a Gangster
The Underworld Gangster Is a Little Adorable
Zhe Ge Heidao You Dian Meng

title.romaji: Zhe Ge Baobiao You Dian Meng

189990.description:
Chiu Kang, known online as Kang Chi, is one of the best players in DC. To him, the real world feels dull and inefficient, so he pours everything into mastering the game. Yet... even at the top, life feels hollow. That all changed one day on his way home from the internet café. After a sudden accident, he wakes up not as Chiu Kang—but as Kella Caldern, the Demon King’s son.

(Source: Tapas)

189991.description:
A cynical noblewoman cursed to hear others' thoughts struggles to control her childhood friend—a wildly powerful mage whose flirting is as explosive as his unchecked magic. His outrageous marriage proposals ("I'll conquer the empire for you!") and her exasperated damage control create a hilarious magical rom-com where keeping him sane might just drive her mad first.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: It’s Annoying Because My Childhood Friend Is An Archmage

189992.description:
What does the "Wu" in Wuxia truly mean? It is the power to enforce one's chivalry—to wield justice not just for oneself, but to shape the world by sheer strength. And if that strength transcends the self, flows through others, and reaches to the ends of the world... Then that power is none other than divine. So what does it take for a mere human to ascend to such godhood? To reach the realm of the divine through martial might? Thus begins the epic tale of Pi Wol-ryeo, a warrior in search of that very answer—one forged in blood, will, and iron discipline.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Luoyang Branch of the Heavenly Demon Cult
Heavenly Demon: Birth of a Legend in Luoyang

189993.description:
While on his way home from an interview, unemployed, unmotivated, jaded 18-year-old Inumata Shinogi encounters the beautiful lady and evil spirit Yaergnacht Finsternnis. She demands him to either marry her or die on the spot. He must command the battle against enemies of humanityーthe apostles of god (Highlander), and save the world with his wife!! Battle fantasy with the infatuated strongest kuudere beauty, start!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 黒月のイェルクナハト

189994.description:
The manga centers on Nagisa Hinata, a woman around 30 years old who is despairing after her job isn't going well and she finds out that her boyfriend is cheating on her. She meets a high school boy named Itsuki Seno, who saves Nagisa from someone trying to pick her up while she's feeling down.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 好きにさせないで、樹くん

189995.description:
A youth sports story set in a female corporate team with athletes in multiple sports. Elite salesman Kaneda Keisuke is transferred to the athletics promotion department, where the players of the female corporate team, Asterias, who lost in a factional dispute and became a burden to the company, belong. Kaneda is disheartened after falling from his smooth-sailing life as a company employee. However, he meets the female athletes at Asterias, who are serious about sports...

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: シンデレラアスリーツ

189996.description:
In a certain world, seasonings such as salt and sugar are controlled by the nobles, and fine cuisine is restricted. One day, a drunkard with an unfamiliar appearance appears in front of Tina, who works for an oppressive lord. The man, Ryuji, is immediately sent to prison for his disrespectful remarks to the lord, but he declares to Tina, "If you're hungry, I'll cook for you." This is a gourmet manga in which Ryuji brings modern ingredients to another world and goes on an adventure.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: 異世界リュウジ 至高と虚無のバズレシピ旅
title.romaji: Isekai Ryuuji: Shikou to Kyomu no Buzz Recipe Tabi

189997.description:
1. Fried Egg Moon (ふらいど・えっぐ・む～ん)
2. Fried Chicken Sunday (ふらいど・ちきん・さんでい)
3. Fried Spring Dream (ふらいど・すぷりんぐ・どりーむ)
4. Fried Potato Fry (ふらいど・ぽてと・ふらい)
5. Mahoutsukai no Nichiyoubi (魔法使いの日曜日)
6. Rolling Wagon Koimonogatari (ローリング・ワゴン 恋物語)
7. Mikazuki no Yume wo Sagashite (三日月の夢をさがして)

title.native: ふらいど・えっぐ・む～ん

189998.description:
When Hwang Mok-Yeon’s friend-with-benefits Chae Sun-Hwa proposes a threesome, he’s only mildly intrigued until he hears who the third is. His target? Eun Nan-Jo: wealthy, polite, and perfectly presentable…but, according to Sun-Hwa, hopelessly boring in bed. At first, it’s just curiosity. But once the three of them are tangled in sheets, Mok-Yeon finds he can’t take his eyes off Nan-Jo...not even for a moment. And when he realizes Nan-Jo may be more interested in saving Sun-Hwa than claiming him, Mok-Yeon makes a quiet, dangerous offer. He leans in and says, “I want you. Do you think you could spread your legs for me?”

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
synonyms: สัมพันธ์ลวงรัก

189999.description:
Benjamin Barker, a special agent at the CBI, attempts to apprehend Ian Basti, the boss of a major crime syndicate, only to be overpowered and captured. As Ian's prisoner, Benjamin is subjected to countless forms of sexual torture and even abandoned by his fellow agents. Despite this, he decides to stay by Ian's side to learn more about the inner workings of the organization and their drug operations. Will Benjamin survive this ordeal, or will the mob boss's grasp suffocate his escape plans?

(Source: Lezhin US)
